strings.GER_THENEWORDER_DESC:
Once humbled by their failures in the Weltkrieg, Germany once more rose to prominence with the leadership of Adolf Hitler in the 1930s. Thanks to the failures of the Allies, WW2 has ended in complete German victory.

Germany now presides over the most powerful Empire on Earth, but despite her victory, Germany's control remains tenuous at best. Wracked by an economic crash that has frozen the nation for a decade, and with a massive slave caste providing for the German people, the population has began to protest. The nation is now trapped in a series of student protests and the machinations of the Deutsche Bank.
strings.GER_super_heavy_tank_equipment_desc: The Maus is in the Haus.
strings.GER_super_heavy_tank_equipment_1_desc: The Maus is in the Haus.
strings.GER_MAN_desc: Most known for the Panther tank, MAN also participated in design and production of earlier Panzer models.
strings.GER_sp_rockets_flying_bomb_desc: Vergeltungswaffe 1. A rocket powered flying bomb, capable of hitting our enemies from distance, destroying their war industry, without needing trained pilots, this truly is a weapon that can change the outcome of a war.
strings.GER_sp_rockets_ballistic_missile_desc: Vergeltungswaffe 2. A guided ballistic missile, capable of delivering a warhead from great distances with unprecedented speed and accuracy.
strings.GER_Subcontinental_Crisis_buildup_desc: Our friend and ally in Asia, Pakistan, finds itself under a new threat - a hardline, pseudo-Bolshevist government has come to power in India, and they seek to destroy Pakistan's ability to defend itself, and see it annexed into India yet again. Japan's claws are evident in this new approach, with their government giving full backing to India's aggression. We must act immediately to preserve our ally's sovereignty, or else years of German effort will be wasted.
strings.GER_Subcontinental_Crisis_confrontation_: Our friend and ally in Asia, Pakistan, finds itself under a new threat - a hardline, pseudo-Bolshevist government has come to power in India, and they seek to destroy Pakistan's ability to defend itself, and see it annexed into India yet again. Japan's claws are evident in this new approach, with their government giving full backing to India's aggression. We must act immediately to preserve our ally's sovereignty, or else years of German effort will be wasted.

strings.GER_SC_deescalate_desc: This is getting out of control. We cannot let a war break out at any cost.
strings.GER_Espionage_operation_schild_flag_1: The Germans did not betray us.
strings.GER_Channel_Crisis_buildup_desc: As if the problems in Africa and the east weren't bad enough, our hold over Great Britain has completely collapsed. A heinous group of Judeo-Bolshevik gangsters have toppled the government and seized the strategically vital bulwark, and with it our seaways into the ocean. No one knows for sure what they'll do next; there is no letting this happen. It is a shame we cannot respond yet with the Heer paralyzed, but we will prepare. It's only a matter of time.
strings.GER_Channel_Crisis_confrontation_desc: The American puppetmasters behind the marauders in Britain have shown their true colors, and in a brazen act of insanity is now using the threat of annihilation to stop us from restoring order. They will regret ever doing so when we show that the might of the continent is not to be trifled with. Still, we must recognize that the situation is now highly dangerous. If attempts to force their retreat fail, we may have to resort to coercing as much as we can out of them...

If OFN Readiness is high, it will decrease by 30%
But if OFN Readiness is low, the decision will backfire and it will increase by 35%
strings.GER_CC_bump_american_warship_tt:

strings.GER_CC_negotiations_desc: Perhaps we can accept Britain's new status if we can get an agreement that alleviates the risks of this new Britain and ensure this may only happen on our terms. But are we sure we want to compromise with this unpredictable threat?
strings.GER_CC_stoke_fears_of_war_in_us_media: Stoke Fears of War in U.S. Media
strings.GER_CC_deescalate_desc: This is getting out of control. We cannot let a war break out at any cost.
strings.GER_IBC_desc:
The British Isles have become the newest hot commodity of the Cold War. The Einheitspakt and the Organization of Free Nations both eagerly vie for her membership, and are attempting to court it through various means. This battle of influence lies on a knife's edge however. Should one of these factions' influence overpower that of England's, they will be forced to join a faction, as reliance on their military and economic might becomes a must. Overpowering the influence of America will surely grant us a victory in the Cold War.

Influence of the Einheitspakt, the Organization of Free Nations, and {getenglandunificationenglandorbritain} herself:

Influence of {usa_getflag}The United States of America and the Organization of Free Nations: [?ENG.ENG_OFN_Influence]
{usa_getflag}Their influence will increase by [?ENG.ENG_OFN_Influence_Increase] every month.

Influence of {ger_getflag}The German Reich and the Einheitspakt: [?ENG.ENG_EP_Influence]
{ger_getflag}Their influence will increase by [?ENG.ENG_EP_Influence_Increase] every month.

Influence of {eng_getflag}{getenglandunificationenglandorbritain}: [?ENG.ENG_Independent_Influence]
{eng_getflag}{getenglandunificationenglandorbritain}'s influence will increase by [?ENG.ENG_Independent_Influence_Increase] every month.

Currently {getfactioncategoryleader} is in the lead.
strings.GER_Faction_Join_OFN_Mission_desc: Our diplomats have expressed their concern that if the diplomatic situation is to continue in this course, {getenglandunificationenglandorbritain} will join the {usa_getflag} United States and the Organization of Free Nations at the end of this diplomatic standoff.
strings.GER_Faction_Join_Pakt_Mission_desc: Our diplomats have informed us that if the diplomatic situation is to continue in this course, {getenglandunificationenglandorbritain} will join us in the Einheitspakt, strengthening our position in the Cold War.
strings.GER_Faction_Close_Faction_Mechanic_Missi: Our diplomats have expressed their concern that if the diplomatic situation is to continue in this course, {getenglandunificationenglandorbritain} may decide to stay neutral in the Cold War.
strings.GER_Faction_Join_OFN_Mission.tt: {eng_getflag}{getenglandunificationenglandorbritain} will join the Organization of Free Nations.
strings.GER_Bormann_Foreign_Policy_Burgundy_Coll: The deviant traitor, Heinrich Himmler, has finally led his puny fiefdom to its deserved end. The so-called 'Ordensstaat' is being torn apart from within by degenerate elements, including the SS itself - delicious irony! Now is the time for the Reich to reclaim its rightful western border, along with whatever scraps of France and Belgium were illegally seized by Himmler during the Bürgerkrieg. The Führer's lasting triumph will be built atop the mass grave of the Schutzstaffel!
strings.GER_Speer_Foreign_Policy_Burgundy_Collap: After twelve long years, the renegade Ordensstaat Burgund has finally run out of luck. Reichsführer Himmler's mismanagement and megalomania have led to mass revolts breaking out among both the French populace and the Waffen-SS legions; everyone save for his inner circle is up in arms. We must seize this opportunity to bind and butcher the hydra if we wish to cleanse Europe of the SS forever - and seize it we shall!
strings.GER_agent_operations_tt: We will continue to support German agents within Central Asia that when, their operations complete, will increase tensions within the conference.
strings.GER_delegates_lobbying_tt: We will begin lobbying support from various factions within Central Asia.
strings.GER_Brute_Force_Delegates_tt: We will have the Turkestan Legion use threats and violence to pressure more delegates to support German interests, while increasing tension.
strings.GER_Increase_German_Support_desc: Whatever needs to be done will be done - we will increase delegates loyal to us however we can.
strings.GER_Support_Agent_Operations_desc: {getintelagencyshort} is the best intelligence agency in the world - we will put it to use. Bombings, assassinations- we will increase tension significantly.
strings.GER_Brute_Force_Delegates_desc: Our intelligence agency will continue to do what they do best - lie, blackmail, threaten - anything to get delegates on our side.
strings.GER_increase_suspicion_desc: Under the table deals, whispered promises, covert handshakes - we must spread chaos and increase suspicion at the conference - specifically, against Japan.
strings.GER_increase_tension_desc: We will go further into the deep end- we must continue to cement Germany's primacy in Central Asia.
strings.GER_send_advisors_to_the_legion_desc: It's not our first time sending Wehrmacht advisors to an aligned nation - and it certainly will not be the last. The Legion must be able to defend itself - and we will help them.
strings.GER_attack_samarqand_desc: Samarqand sits in a tactically significant location - it must be taken. We will “convince” the Legion to help fix this problem. This will massively increase tension.
strings.GER_attack_ishkoshim_desc: Ishkoshim sits in a tactically significant location - it must be taken. We will “convince” the Legion to help fix this problem. This will massively increase tension.
strings.GER_attack_tashkent_desc: Tashkent sits in a tactically significant location - it must be taken. We will “convince” the Legion to help fix this problem. This will massively increase tension.
strings.GER_colombia.1.t: SUBJECT: Status of the Segundo Ejército Patriótico in Atlántico
strings.GER_colombia.1.SPA:
1. At approximately 4:00 AM (UTC-5), the Second Patriotic Army (SPA) initiated a large-scale offensive which in a matter of hours captured the invaluable port city of Barranquilla for use as a springboard in its Laureanist “rebirth” of the Republic. In speed and unit cohesion, the SPA greatly outperformed our expectations, and suffered half the expected casualties.

2. Colombia is of immense geostrategic importance to the Reich, with the potential to provide access to the Pacific Ocean, hinder US efforts to promote far-left groups in Ecuador, Peru, and Paraguay, and enable deeper ties between Germania and other South American countries. Further, the SPA's leadership is all but unconditionally supportive of any potential backer, and has privately indicated enthusiastic willingness to increase ties with the Einheitspakt.

3. Colombian Armed Forces have so far succeeded in containing the SPA to the Northeast, but lack the heavy equipment and manpower needed to launch a counteroffensive for the foreseeable future. However, the civilian population has been generally uncooperative with the SPA, and frequent encounters with insurgents are rapidly depleting military equipment stockpiles. These issues render the SPA unable to expand its territorial control at present, and may become an existential threat to the movement. Without considerable external assistance, the chance of the SPA succeeding against the Republic is slim.

4. Recognizing these circumstances, our agents recommend in the strongest possible terms a further escalation of UNTERNEHMEN CATTLEYA. in particular, the scale of arms-smuggling operations should be greatly expanded, and civilian advisors should be sent to prepare Uribe's administration.

MAY GERMANY BE IN SAFE HANDS
strings.GER_colombia.1.COL:
1. At approximately 4:00 AM (UTC-5), the Second Patriotic Army (SPA) has risen up and secured the invaluable port city of Barranquilla for use as a springboard in our efforts to secure Colombia. In speed and unit cohesion, the SPA greatly outperformed our expectations, and suffered half the expected casualties.

2. Colombia is of immense geostrategic importance to the Reich, with the potential to provide access to the Pacific Ocean, hinder US efforts to promote groups in Ecuador, Peru, and Paraguay, and enable deeper ties between Germania and other South American countries. Further, the Urdaneta Government is supportive of the NSDAP, and has privately indicated enthusiastic willingness to align with the Einheitspakt.

3. The détente between the Laureanist Government and José Camacho Carreño provide a shift in the plan to use him to align Colombia. Reports from Heriberto Schwartau detail the new plan of action. In exchange for aid in the Civil War, the PCC has accepted to deepen ties with the possibility of replacing the Iberian as their ally in the future.

4. Recognizing these circumstances, our agents recommend in the strongest possible terms a further escalation of UNTERNEHMEN CATTLEYA. in particular, the scale of shipping operations should be greatly expanded, and military advisors should be sent to secure PCC alignment.

MAY GERMANY BE IN SAFE HANDS
strings.GER_colombia.1.a: Let's see if the Monroe Doctrine holds up
strings.GER_AFRIKA_germany_is_stable: As long as Germany is stable, the guns shall keep on coming
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.1:
In all of history, many men have come to dominate Europe. Augustus Caesar, Charles V, Napoleon. Yet no man nor nation has ever laid their enemies low so decisively nor governed with such evil a purpose as Adolf Hitler and the Großgermanisches Reich.

With the world prostrated before her, Germany is master of Europe. The true extent of her power stretches far beyond her borders, for no corner of Earth was left untouched by the Reich's victory or its consequences. Free to indulge in its National Socialist dogma, the Reich has spent the last decades striving for its brutal final goals - the making of an Aryan utopia and the exploitation and destruction of countless “Untermenschen” in the way. As Hitler ages, though, the troubles of this system grow impossible to ignore. Its constant, structural cruelty, paired with complacent incompetence, has fractured the very foundation of the nation. What happens when the last bonds which tie the Reich together fade away?
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.2:
Germany's greatest test would come on September 1st, 1939, when the jackboots of the Wehrmacht stormed across the Polish border. Within two years, the entire continent and far beyond was embroiled in the greatest war ever seen. What stunned most observers more than sheer scale, however, was the utter and total success of the Axis in its fight against the rest of the world.

Poland was the first to collapse under the weight of the Blitzkrieg. Numerous Allied nations soon followed her. Finally, two titanic struggles broke out in Europe, more brutal and devastating than any campaign before - the gigantic battles of the Eastern Front and the slow grind of Operation Sea Lion. Even in the face of these enormous challenges, however, the Reich was unstoppable. The massive resources poured into Britain and Russia were not enough to prevent their collapse, and the atom bomb forced America from the war soon after. Hitler, once a destitute veteran in Munich, now had all of Europe in his fist. The Reich was victorious.
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.3:
By the end of 1945, Germany was the unquestionable master of Europe. Her empire stretched from Marseille to Arkhangelsk. Alongside puppet governments in the west, brutal Reichskommissariats were created in the east, cruel colonial governments which entwined greedy resource extraction with the final, genocidal goal of Lebensraum. It was this complete hegemony which further fed the bloodthirsty, demonic machine, accelerating the deterioration of German dominance.

Overlooked in the expenses, however, were the equally vast number of furious enemies organizing across the borders, as well as the increasingly distressing financial reports or cooling diplomatic relations. All at once, the walls fell in - the economy collapsed, Germany's distant allies severed their ties, and the West Russian Revolutionary Front surged over the eastern frontier in unthinkable numbers. The West Russian War had begun.
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.4:
The West Russian War would tear away the veneer of German invincibility with all the rage it deserved. The Heer, revered at home for so long, was routed by Russian “Untermenschen” armed with inferior equipment and less resources. As the spearheads of the West Russians blew apart resistance, the East collapsed into total chaos. When German forces fled Paulusburg, the Thousand Year Reich teetered on oblivion.

In such a desperate environment, it was no surprise that the shadowy Heinrich Himmler and his SS would make an attempt to seize the reins of state. However, the Heer broke up the conspiracy before it had a chance to fully fire, leading to the destruction and exile of much of the SS to the Ordenstaat and the turning of the tide in the East. The Front, exhausted by its push, finally ran out of steam and collapsed under the weight of the reorganized German forces. By the skin of its teeth, Germany had survived another close call - but the rot had been exposed, and it would not be removed so easily.
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.5:
The German Reich had survived its closest call yet, but the trouble which plagued it remained. With its eastern holdings in shambles and the economy in the gutter, it would take years for Germany's slave-driven economic schemes to even restore a stagnant equilibrium. Meanwhile, the Heer used its defeats as a way to divert even more funds to its bloated coffers while ignoring the troubles which plagued it. Hitler, himself weakening in strength, increasingly lost control of his four most powerful subordinates - Bormann, Speer, Göring, and Heydrich.

The German eagle no longer soars. It trundles along, weighed down by its complete moral bankruptcy. Corruption, vanity, and wanton cruelty are the mottos of her administrators, and the increasingly desperate people seek any sort of solution for their woes. The hate which the Reich exports is finally turning inwards, and all that remains to hold the people together is a fading, senile Hitler. What will happen when his time is up?
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.6: He With Power- The Führer is Germany, and Germany is the Führer. That is the party line, the truth the NSDAP set in the world and that Hitler finally confirmed in the course of the Second World War. When victory came, it did so in glory the Reich had not seen in close to a century - her eternal enemies beaten, crushed under the greatest war-machine the world had ever seen. Hitler became the lynchpin of this glory and to this day his name is written with any mention of it, alongside those innumerable crimes committed in the process. What followed was a decade of prosperity and power, where the Reich stood as the unquestioned hegemon of the world - and utter despair and tragedy in the years after, where the people saw it all crumble to dust. The Führer is not there to notice it, however. Though his eyes still see and his voice still rasps, the sharpness and instinct is gone, and the strength is following. It will not be long until Germany's most consequential leader leaves it behind.
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.7:
Beyond Hitler's grasp lies the vast overgrowth of bureaucracy which dominates modern Germania, bloated and fat on its blood-stained treasures. Within its concrete facade lies a morass of back-stabbing and immoral ambition. In this political viper's nest, only the smartest and strongest men can thrive.

Today's establishment politics are dominated by Martin Bormann, Hitler's right-hand man with a nose for power and a complete lack of a moral compass. His weaseling and conniving has firmly planted him as the leader of the conservative majority. He is not without challenge, however. Albert Speer, a sharp schemer in his own right, has turned himself into a leader of those in Germany who cry out for reform to the broken system.

If all was to go to plan, it would be one of these men who would become the next Führer - but every day makes it more and more clear that succession will not be so orderly.
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.8:
Though being outside of Germania means an ambitious politician has less opportunity to wheel and deal, the Volkshalle's endless scheming means that avoiding the morass has its own benefits. Such is the idea for those who style themselves as the next Führer, dodging the swamp in favor of forging their own path to power.

Hermann Göring, the charismatic ace of years past, has found himself the leader of the powerful militarist faction. His popularity with the citizenry grants him widespread appeal - something Reinhard Heydrich, deputy leader of the SS, could not be further from. His power comes from fear and the shadowy backing of his superior, Heinrich Himmler. Though few see him as the next Führer, that hasn't stopped him and his supporters from trying.

These outside candidates surely believe in their ability to lead, but it may be more prudent for them to dust off their military experience first.
strings.GER_CountryInfo_Content_desc.9:
In the chaotic self-devouring nature of the Reich's politics, little stands above the melee. The Heer, those proud defenders of the Fatherland, are no exception. While they portray themselves as supreme Aryan leaders and warriors, the truth of the matter is that the armed forces are as involved in the power plays and the scheming as any.

The modern Heer is primarily split between moderates and militarists, respectively led by Hans Speidel and Ferdinand Schörner. On Speidel's side lie men like Henning von Tresckow and Dietrich von Saucken, united in their opposition to the blatant tinkering of the militarists. For their part, the Militarists lay claim to men like Otto Remer and Hermann Göring - driven, ambitious bloodhounds who wish to reach glory through conquest.

Both sides are inexorably opposed to one another, more focused on defeating their internal rivals than protecting the Reich itself. Will they truly be ready?
strings.GER_Espionage_sabotage_mission_success_t: the mission succeeding, sabotaging the target's infrastructure.
strings.GER_Espionage_coup_mission_success_tt: the mission succeeding, overthrowing the target's government.
strings.GER_HGR_Anti_Himmler_desc:
The name of the Anti-Himmler-Koalition is somewhat unnecessary, in the eyes of many Germans. After all, practically everyone has been against Himmler for decades, outside of the SS. Still, the name fits well for the expansive, disorderly alliance that ammasses against the black masses of Himmler's legions - including Himmler's former protégé, Reinhard Heydrich, who leads the Koalition. Truly, any movement that encompasses everything from democrats to militarists to SS men is a coalition borne purely of hatred for a greater evil.

It is that evil alone, who plots and schemes the end of the world in Nanzig, who holds his opponents together. When he dies, the coalition will go with him, and the forces of a united opposition will break apart once more. Even with this in mind, the members know that scheming against one another borders on foolish, for what is the point in plotting for tomorrow if the world might end today?
strings.GER_bor_saw_desc:
INVOLVEMENT: {getborsawinvolvement} ([?GER_Bormann_SAW_involvement|Y1]%)
PROTEST: {getborsawprotest} ([?GER_Bormann_SAW_civilian_protest|Y1]%)

Our strategy is currently {getborsawstrategy}.

The South African War was not instigated or even intended by the Führer, but we can nonetheless profit from it. Whether we push the United States out of Africa or withdraw will have repercussions.

In spite of all this, the civilian population is protesting our involvement in this war already. We must carefully balance their demands and our plans, or be forced to withdraw.
strings.GER_congo_civil_war_desc: Afrika was lost to us, yet it seems our troubles in the continent are not over. With the Congo falling to chaos, the German administration in Léopoldville has requested our support - and if we answer, perhaps there lies an opportunity to at least recover a portion of what we lost.
strings.GER_Madagascar_desc:
Whereas Madagascar is French by law, it is the Greater Germanic Reich that has kept it in order until the recent rebellion. This setback is being exploited by other global powers, notably the Japanese. We
cannot tolerate losing the region; we will fight
to the last Malagasy to maintain control.
strings.GER_make_the_french_pay_their_dues: Force the French to Commit Militarily
strings.GER_MADCW_French_send_1_unit_tt: Mainland French Divisions will arrive, dispatched from the Paris government.
strings.GER_MADCW_folks_rise_tt: French Divisions will rise up in this state and claim it!
strings.GER_MADCW_US_fucking1_tt: America will provide less aid for some time due to this.
strings.GER_MADCW_US_fucking_tt: Targeting Japanese sympathetic Malagasy leaders will divide the alliance between Japan and America.
strings.GER_MADCW_america_do_less_tt: American Interference will be partially exposed which will limit what America can do in the span of 2 weeks.
strings.GER_MADCW_america_do_less_2_tt: American Interference will be partially exposed which will limit what America can do in the span of 2 weeks.
strings.GER_Maurice_Decisions_TT: Emil Maurice is in American captivity. Decisions in the Africa tab of the Intelligence Menu have been unlocked, if we can act soon enough we may preempt American action on his captivity.
strings.GER_Maurice_InterceptKill:
We cannot afford to let Maurice survive. He must be killed.
Decisions in the Caribbean America tab of the Intelligence Menu have been unlocked.
strings.GER_IBW_PW_desc: Our control over Eastern Europe is unmatched, though dubious in the west. Now Iberia has collapsed, and the Falangists have again emerged. If they succeed, we will have access to the Atlantic, and reaffirm ourselves as the uncontested Masters of Europe.
strings.GER_Plane_Bombing_desc:
The outbreak of war with the German puppet has brought the wrath of the Luftwaffe down upon us. Bombs rain down upon critical infrastructure and military installations and our ability to offer resistance in the air is minimal.

This will disrupt the organisation of our forces and will damage domestic support for the war effort, but we have little choice but to press on and hope that this bombardment does not escalate further.
strings.GER_military_advisors_desc: Our friends in the Reich have seen fit to dispatch advisors from the Wehrmacht to aid our armed forces in the current conflict. With their support we shall see a significant improvement in the overall performance of our soldiers, as well as learning important lessons about modern warfare which will improve the efficiency of our armed forces in the future.
strings.GER_technician_aid_desc: The Reich has seen fit to dispatch technicians to aid our war effort and we are already seeing significant benefits to a range of different areas of our military and economy as a result. We can only hope that aid such as this continues to be forthcoming.
strings.GER_sabotage_effort_desc:
The outbreak of war with the German puppet has resulted in the Abwehr being unleashed against us. A wave of sabotage has swept our country as their agents set to work stealing state secrets, sabotaging military operations, and assassinating officials.

This is proving detrimental to the war effort, not only because of the direct consequences of the sabotage but also because of the paranoia gripping our government as our own agents struggle to prevent further damage.
strings.GER_Wehrmacht_Technicians_desc: The Reich has seen fit to dispatch army technicians to aid our war effort and we are already seeing significant benefits to a range of different areas of our military and economy as a result. We can only hope that aid such as this continues to be forthcoming.
strings.GER_saf_withdrawal_desc:
What was an attempt at triumph by rogue Reichskommissariats has taken its toll on the Reich, recovering from the horrors of the Bürgerkrieg only to be thrown into a pointless conflict. With our near total grip on German society gone, pressure from elements inside the government and the civilians have forced us to conduct a withdrawal from the war.

We have exactly 1 year to properly conduct a withdrawal of our military forces from Afrika before the materiel advantage of South Africa and the OFN turns the tide of the war against the Reichskommissariats and severely disrupting our future plans for Afrika.

However, should we exceed the deadline or if the war ends in the OFN's favour before our withdrawal is complete, we will have to rush our withdrawal, causing our plans to fall in disarray. We must act quickly.
strings.GER_withdrawal_text: Withdrawal progress is at {getgerwithdrawalcolor}{GER_withdrawal_var}% towards completion.
strings.GER_SAW_Withdrawal_Modify_Progress_add_t: Our withdrawal progress will be increased by [?GER_withdrawal_var_change?4|=2]%, bringing it to [?GER_withdrawal_var_temp|2]%.
strings.GER_SAW_Withdrawal_Modify_Progress_sub_t: Our withdrawal progress will be decreased by [?GER_withdrawal_var_change?4|=2]%, bringing it to [?GER_withdrawal_var_temp|2]%.
strings.GER_PP_invasion_desc:
Spies in Havana and Washington have delivered reports to us detailing the training of the “Caribbean Legion,” a group of political dissidents and mercenaries preparing for an invasion of the Dominican Republic to overthrow dictator Rafael Trujillo. Despite Trujillo's steadfast alignment to Iberia, we may find that humiliating the Americans in their own backyard could prove valuable.

American air assets will likely be used in the conflict and prove devastating to D.R. forces. In response, engineers in the Wehrmacht have begun strongly advocating for the shipment of anti-air weapons especially new technologies for field testing. We should not pass up valuable experience and photos of downed U.S. pilots on the news.
strings.GER_PP_ceasefire_desc:
Despite our efforts, the Puerto Plata Invasion has come to a ceasefire with the Legion holding territory in the North while Trujillo has been replaced by Balaguer. More alarming are the rumors that the Americans and Iberians could negotiate some sort of a long term peace settlement. This is unacceptable.

We have inserted multiple teams of the Brandenburgers, Germany's finest and most elite special forces operatives. Living as if they were guerrillas in the mountains, they will conduct a variety of sabotage and destabilizing operations to trigger continued fighting. And while we need to keep them well supplied, larger more ambitious operations could come with some hefty risks.
strings.GER_PP_ceasefire_text:
The current £GFX_discontent_texticon Tension is {getppceasefiretension}.
Our current level of £GFX_green_mbt_texticon Preparation is [?DOM.PPI_ceasefire_military_preparation]
strings.GER_PPI_Bribe_Legion_Soldiers_tt: We can now exert internal influence on the Frontist Forces!
strings.GER_PPI_Bribe_DR_Pilots_tt: We can now exert internal influence on the Balaguerist Forces!
strings.GER_ffr_reclamation_desc:
For decades now, the inability of the legitimate French Government to curtail the influence of the French Resistance has been a blight on Germany's attempts to maintain its influence over western europe, countless amounts of economic and military aid have born little results, now, most insultingly, they have allowed an old ghost of our conquest of the perfidious French Republic to come back to haunt us.

The reemergence of our enemy on French soil is an insult to the Aryan Race, forsooth, the old rivalry shall henceforth be rekindled again.
strings.GER_french_civil_war_desc:
The political instability of the French State gave rise into a full blown civil war. While this result is not surprising given the signs from the last 10 years, having so much chaos this close to the Rhine - our natural defense line - is deleterious to the stability of the Reich.

Adding insult to injury, reliable intel from the Mediterranean coast of France tells us of movements of troops bearing a tricolor with the Cross of Lothringen, the symbol of the accursed gaullists. We must squash and then quickly remove them from public light.

strings.GER_CLD_send_volunteers_desc: Our Colombian brothers-in-arms are embroiled in a brutal civil war. We will help them by sending volunteers.
strings.GER_COL_provide_loans_to_the_CLD_desc: We will provide a series of loans to our allies in Colombia to help keep them in the fight, Colombia will be free of the blight of liberalism and communism.
strings.GER_CCW_desc: Colombia lies in ruin; the fragile peace, the frozen war, that the nation has been in for the last decade has melted, and Colombians once again fight with blade and rifle for what they believe in. Colombia lies directly in the United States' backyard- and we are presented with the unique opportunity to humiliate them within it. By supporting our partners in the region, who stand proud against the pretender states such as the fascists of New Granada and the socialists in the Colombian Revolutionary Union, we can bring a piece of Latin America into our sphere of influence- and open up the continent to our interests. It is important that we do not squander this opportunity.
strings.GER_RAC_desc:
Hans Hüttig has occupied the other African Reichskommissariats, declaring the Großafrikanischer Reichsstaat. Fighting against him is a small clique of officers and administrators who call themselves the “African Cabal,” loyal to Germania. While they are too weak to act independently, with our help they'll be able to resist Hüttig's mad reign. We must also protect the Cabal from the decay it will undergo once Hüttig notices its prevalence.

Alternatively... the cabal situation could be manipulated to our political advantage back in the heimat, at the cost of its chances of overthrowing Hüttig.

Cabal Strength: ([?GRO.GRO_REICHSSTAAT_cabal_power|%1])
Decay: ([?GRO.GRO_REICHSSTAAT_cabal_decay|%1])

The cabal's strength will dictate its odds of succeeding upon the collapse of the Reichsstaat...
strings.GER_cabal_supply_weapons_desc: There is irony to be found in the fact that we are funding partisans to undermine our own former colony. Still, we can't deny that we need to resort to such methods to weaken Hüttig's stranglehold over Africa: by arming loyal Germans who still fight for the remnants of Zentralafrika and Südwestafrika, we'll force the madman to overstretch his already-meagre forces, reducing his control over the abomination he calls “state” and strengthening our allies.
strings.GER_cabal_administrative_aid_desc: The Cabal fights every single day, not only to undermine Hüttig's hold over the continent, but also to keep their heads on their neck. This is far more than a metaphor, as Hüttig is known for his tendency to resort to mass executions for the slightest hint of treason: by sending our secret services to help them, we can make sure that Hüttig is kept too busy with other problems to bother with discovering our friends.
strings.GER_cabal_cover_em_desc: As the last loyal men in Bouhlerstadt work to undermine the madman Hüttig, we must ensure that they are not discovered. By burning certain paper trails and constructing falsified ones in their place, we can avert suspicion of our agents in Africa, at least for now.
strings.GER_cabal_fund_them_desc: The Cabal is an expensive endeavor, requiring a wide web of agents and bribes to expand their power base and remain hidden from Hüttig's paranoid eye. By granting our allies secret funds, we can strengthen their connections and ensure they can keep being useful to the Reich.
strings.GER_cabal_siphon_funds_desc: Our friends in the Cabal can be very much useful to us. By exploiting their connections, we can steal money and siphon funds from the coffers of our rogue colony: while highly beneficial for our budget, this will surely put several members of the clique at risk of being discovered, and we all know what happens when Hüttig catches someone with their hands on his money...
strings.GER_cabal_implicate_political_enemies_de: While the Cabal's first and foremost task is protecting our interests in Africa, they have... other uses which may prove highly beneficial to us. For instance, what would happen if someone who opposes our reforms was found in possession of documents proving deep and extremely compromising connections to none other than Hans Hüttig, a traitor Reichskommissar who illegally occupies our colonies in Africa and has thrown his lots with the likes of Himmler.
strings.GER_cabal_hide_funding_desc: Hüttig and his minions are getting suspicious as of late, due to our activities or their own raging paranoia. It would be wise to scale down our efforts for a while, and use our secret services to cover any leftover trace of our secret funding. Between us, CIA, the Tokumusoukan and the SIM, literally everyone in the world has a reason to undermine the Reichsstaat, something that makes it very easy to lay the blame on everyone but us...
strings.GER_cabal_provide_training_desc: The forces of the Cabal are few and weak compared to the SS serving Hüttig. Every man counts, and we need to ensure that they'll be ready when the madman's little empire inevitably collapses. Through our secret services, we'll infiltrate special teams charged with providing training in both asymmetric warfare and counterintelligence, increasing their ability to protect themselves from Hüttig's paranoia, and to resist when everything crumbles around them.

strings.GER_OBQ_desc: India burns, and its own armies have lit the match. After the betrayal of the Indian Legion to the Sphere, we have begun to look to other methods of seeing our influence thrive in the region, and we finally found able allies in the form of the Pakistan Movement, a strongly pro-European faction with links to our own Muslim allies and our British friends. India may be beyond our grasp, but seeing part of it cut away forever, now that its military might is on the other side of the country - that is achievable.
strings.GER_OBQ_PAK_claims_overview_desc: The Pakistan movement claims these lands as their own. We must ensure they control all of it in order for them to succeed. You may view the highlighted regions on the world map.

strings.GER_Theodor_Oberlander_hog_desc:
Reichstagpräsident
Idiosyncratic Nazism
--------------
Highly educated, highly opinionated, and highly controversial - Theodor Oberländer, the President of the Reichstag, is an anomaly amongst the ranks of the NSDAP. Speerites consider him a conservative, even a reactionary. Orthodox National Socialists, however, see Oberländer as a reformer - and a lesser evil compared to Speer - one who would push for a great deal of social change and reform in the Reich's aching structures, yet try to keep the ideology alive.

After receiving doctorates in Economics and Agriculture, Theodor Oberländer went on to serve in the Abwehr, eventually leading the Special Group Bergman in Ukraine. Oberländer was, however, eventually removed from this position following a series of missives to the Führer in which he criticized racial policies such as Generalplan Ost as misapplied National Socialism.

Far from killing his career, however, this pushed Oberländer into the political sector. Campaigning from his position as a professor at Prague University, Oberländer managed to secure a seat in the Reichstag. At first one of the earliest members of the NSDAP's reformist faction, Oberländer split with Speer when it became clear to the doctor that the architect cared more about appealing to students and liberals than correcting ideological failings. While no faction loves Oberländer's ideas, it is clear many of the Reich's people do.
strings.GER_Martin_Bormann_hog_desc:
Parteiminister
National Socialism
--------------
The masses cheer Hitler, the army salutes Göring, and the intellectuals admire Speer's oppressive architecture. Yet how many Germans would recognise Parteiminister Martin Bormann, the little grey man lurking in the Führer's shadow?

Men of grand goals often boast humble beginnings. Born to a postman at the turn of the century, Martin Bormann lived through the First World War to become an estate manager of a farm. Violence was never far behind the young man. He was imprisoned for assisting the brutal murder of a school teacher, became a treasurer for the Freikorps, and leapt into the SA with thuggish vigor. An obsessive administrator with bureaucratic finesse, Bormann eventually joined Hitler's Inner Circle as the Chief of the Party Chancellery.

Over the last two decades, the Brown Eminence has weaved a web of deception, bribery, and blackmail, coalescing power around himself with appointments, promotions, and firings. He sits at the heart of this web, smoking a cigar, fawning pathetically before his superiors while treating his subordinates like cattle. His opponents consider him a crude and uncultured parvenu who has transformed the NSDAP into his own corrupt plaything; his supporters preach loyalty so long as they can maintain their positions of power. While despised by many, the Parteiminister has entrenched his position by standing firm against the growing forces of revision and reaction.

As the Führer's health fails, will the Brown Eminence finally step out of the shadows?
strings.GER_Hermann_Goring_sec_desc:
Reichsmarschall
National Socialism
--------------
If Adolf Hitler is the undisputed father of the German Reich, Hermann Göring is its beloved uncle. Born in 1893 to Heinrich Ernst Göring, the former governor of Südwestafrika. An early follower of the Führer, Göring has been by Hitler's side since the early days of the Nazi Party in the 1920s. He was a prominent member in the abortive Munich Putsch of 1923 and prominent party leader. His loyalty has not gone unrecognized or unrewarded. Once the Nazi Party took power in 1933 he was made Minister-President of Prussia and President of the Reichstag, both positions he held until the 1950s. After his Luftwaffe aided in the stunning victory over France, Hitler bestowed Göring with the title of Reichsmarschall as a symbol of his authority, at least in theory, over the Wehrmacht - second only to Hitler's.

Following the Reich's victory in the Second World War, Reichsmarschall Göring's power seemed more secure than ever, but events quickly transpired to diminish his station. His choice to resign several key positions, including his Reichstag presidency, in protest of the attempted SS coup may have been an act of loyalty to Hitler, but it left him out in the cold when the reformist wing of the NSDAP began to make major pushes in the assembly. In the years since Göring has come to rely more and more on the militarist officers of the Wehrmacht for his base of support, a mutual partnership in which he supplies them political capital in return for the backing of their arms.
strings.GER_Albert_Speer_eco_desc:
Reichswirtschaftsminister
Reformed National Socialism
--------------
Albert Speer is a silver-tongued politician, knowing what to say on just the right occasion; an expert in getting people over to his side with honeyed words and promises tempered by his background as Minister of Armaments and War Production in the Second World War. Under his reign as the Minister of Economics, however, the economy has seen a steady decline, from the massively inefficient post-war economic system of slavery showing its undeniable flaws, to the general sensation of stagnation in Nazi policies. Yet, even though Speer was arguably one of, if not the most important man responsible for engineering the mass slavery in Germany's colonies, today he speaks against the same creation he partook in and encouraged.

After a period of moderate obscurity in the '50s, Speer began an intensive campaign of rallying his support. His supporters are the apathetic men and women who lost their jobs or had their family killed in wars, the technocrats and the reform-minded NSDAP members, the disillusioned National Socialists who were not awarded their promised Aryan utopia, and as a token yet active minority, and the small but slowly growing group of students banking on Speer as their only hope for more radical reform. Each hopes for a different facet of Speer's promises, but nevertheless create a shaky united front of 'reformed' National Socialists.
strings.GER_Walther_Hewel_for_desc:
Reichsminister des Auswärtigen
National Socialism
--------------
In a world of foes both real and imagined, the Reich needs a politician capable of asserting its strength on the world stage. After the downfall of the incompetent Joachim von Ribbentrop, Adolf Hitler appointed his close friend and confidant Walther Hewel as the new Reichsminister for Foreign Affairs. A former coffee salesman, Hewel has scaled the greasy ladder of the Foreign Ministry to become the most important diplomat in the Einheitspakt.

Unlike his boisterous predecessor, the shy and good-natured Hewel has sunk into the bureaucratic background as a tenacious and steadfast Conservative of the NSDAP. While he lacks the dynamic intelligence and independence necessary for being a great Reichsminister, his loyalty to the Führer is unmatched.
strings.GER_the_modern_enigma_desc: If you have this idea, you cheated to get it. Shame on you.
strings.GER_SGR_civil_war_offense_desc: With the Civil War dousing Germany in flames, Albert Speer has rallied a significant number of supporters behind his cause of reformism, ranging from more liberally-aligned students and young men and women, to people generally sick of the Hitlerite regime, and to a new generation of fascists who believe the fat of National Socialism must be trimmed.
strings.GER_hitlers_chosen_successor_desc: Ours is the legitimate government of Germany! Our beloved leader Adolf Hitler stood before the Reichstag and named our regime as his rightful successors for all the world to see. All others are traitors, and the German people flock to fight for Hitler's rightful heir.
strings.GER_speer_new_kindof_war: Studying the New Kind of War
strings.GER_speer_ss_restricted_desc:
Any citizens that have ever served the Schutzstaffel will be subject to intense background searches. If they are suspected of having ties or sympathies towards the rogue state in the west, they will be disbarred from joining.

If any of their family members have formerly been part of any Schutzstaffel organization, they will also be subject to background searches, and the persons involved must agree to proclaim that, regardless of there is evidence found in relation to their past about the Schutzstaffel and organisations similar or allied to it, they will swear an oath to protect and serve the Reich.
strings.GER_speer_find_reformers_desc: The Führer, in close cooperation with Henning von Tresckow and his assorted allies, will be making reforms within the Wehrmacht that will seek to reduce the factionalism and conflict within the armed forces, upon which any members seen attempting to form their own cliques, factions, or generally trying to divide the Wehrmacht will be met with severe punishment. Tresckow's own faction of reformists will be encouraged with Albert Speer's political expertise.
strings.GER_speer_new_kindof_war_desc:
Unfortunately for many in the Wehrmacht, modern warfare is not amassing gigantic armies and filling the planes and tanks - well, the latter is true to some extent, but warfare has changed. We can learn from our experiences in the West Russian War, on the importance of logistics, coordination, of manuevering every part of our army together to outwit and outflank the enemy, and to always, always have the upper hand in reconnaissance. It is not a question of whether or not the army will accept this new way of war.

It is a question of when.
strings.GER_speer_sensible_economy_desc: Under the guidance of State Secretary Ludwig Erhard, whose ideas sharply contrast the ones before, the Reich is making a massive shift away from the previous mode of economic control, which relied on strict autarky, protectionism and state control alongside cooperation with conglomerates. Erhard proposes a much more free market-based economy, alongside reaching out to several countries across the world and letting goods flow to and fro Germany, which should help reverse the '50s economic crash.
strings.GER_speer_opening_the_market_desc: Ludwig Erhard has repeatedly badgered that no modern economy can suffice on its own, and must instead rely on export and import with other countries. While this hasn't necessarily resulted with us opening up to the superpowers, we are starting to more actively approach smaller countries who could benefit from our massive amount of resources, and the influx of cash that they could give us - something dearly necessary in this time.
strings.GER_speer_scale_back_milproduction_desc: Given Speer's experience as Reich Economics Minister, he is fully aware of how over bloated the military industry can become very quickly without enough oversight. Though a large and powerful army is extremely helpful, there is a difference between large and powerful, and simply wasteful. Military production will be slowed down under his hand, and the money used to build planes and tanks can be used to build roads and factories and rebuild houses.
strings.GER_HGR_militarists_framed_desc: It has been reported that a number of prominent Wehrmacht officials have been implicated in a plot to suborn portions of the state apparatus. Until the RSHA has completed its investigation, and determined the full extent of the reported conspiracy, military outreach and recruitment has been temporarily suspended in order to ensure that prospective soldiers are not corrupted by the disease that is treason.
strings.GER_HGR_students_quelled_desc: The refusal of significant portions of the German youth to obey the commands of lawful authorities, as well as the violent actions by certain factions amongst them, has necessitated more drastic measures. Insurrection will not be tolerated, and is being responded to with deadly force.
strings.GER_HGR_politicians_silenced_desc: The nomination of Deputy Reichsführer-SS Heydrich by Hitler as his official successor has led to, for the first time in recent memory, open disapproval by both members of the Reichstag as well as provincial officials. This is unacceptable. The Führerprinzip is clear - these politicians must remember their requirement of loyalty to the office of the Führer. Or else.
strings.GER_HGR_ambassadors_expelled_desc: With the domestic unrest currently consuming the Reich, the presence of foreign representatives who could act to unduly influence orderly succession of government can no longer be accepted. They must leave. Now.
strings.GER_HGR_kriegsmarine_pressure_desc: The Kriegsmarine has long been known as the most apolitical branch of the Wehrmacht. This can no longer be permitted. Like everyone else, they will be required to state their continued loyalty both to the state in general and to Heydrich, the Führer's nominated successor, in particular.
strings.GER_bormann_breaks_away: Martin Bormann has left the government.
strings.GER_speer_breaks_away: Albert Speer has left the government.
strings.GER_goring_breaks_away: Hermann Göring has left the government.
strings.GER_prewar_a_bridge_too_far: The Student Protests have crippled Germany.
strings.GER_the_two_principles_tt: The Reich's survival hinges on the Führer's.
strings.GER_gone_over_tt: Cannot train units, disband units, or edit unit templates.
strings.GER_fix_your_shit_pdx:
DEVELOPERS NOTE: If after this event you are unable to select or assign any units, simply save and reload your game and the issue will be resolved.

This is a basegame bug sometimes caused by tag switching, and we can't really do anything about it until Paradox fixes the issue in a future patch.
