strings.GER_SS_preparing_A: We shall directly order the SS to halt their activities.
strings.GER_SS_preparing_B: We shall petition Himmler to stop the SS, even if it makes us look weak.
strings.GER_SS_refuses_A: We will drop the issue, losing face but preventing further humiliation.
strings.GER_SS_refuses_B: We will attempt to take Heydrich prisoner, despite the risks.
strings.GER_SS_accepts_A: The SS will still be watched, and if they have broken their word, we will be humiliated.
strings.GER_SS_accepts_B: We will take the propaganda victory and take the matter no further.
strings.GER_SS_secret_A: We will confront Heydrich and his men and try to end this once and for all.
strings.GER_SS_secret_B: We will cut our losses here.
strings.GER_SS_himmler_agrees: If Himmler lied, it will be humiliating for us.
strings.GER_SS_himmler_refuses_stop_them: We will salvage our authority by cracking down on the German SS ourselves.
strings.GER_SS_himmler_refuses_oh_well: Himmler's authority as an independent ruler will be cemented deeper, and the Reich will be humiliated.
strings.GER_SS_fought_back: We are humiliated and will have to put down these fighters before they all flee.
strings.GER_SS_surrendered: Heydrich will remain in custody, preventing him from causing further unrest, and the SS will be forced back underground.
strings.GER_SS_crushed: Heydrich and his goons were killed, and will be unable to cause us further issues. The SS is also shattered and Burgundy greatly weakened!
strings.GER_gcw_begin_tooltip: The German Civil War will begin...
strings.GER_a_man_on_the_moon_tooltip: Should our effort to land the first man on the surface of the moon prove successful, it will greatly increase our standing on the international stage.
strings.GER_the_enemy_of_my_enemy_tooltip: We will approach the United States of America and attempt to lure them into warming the relations between us with a promise of a joint global effort to contain Japan.
strings.GER_the_speer_proposal_tooltip: We will follow the proposal of Albert Speer for improving our relations with the OFN. This will greatly increase Speer's influence within our government.
strings.GER_ease_the_embargoes_tooltip:
This will increase our national GDP by several billion USD.
Our negotiations with the United States of America must be successful for this to take effect.
strings.GER_the_almighty_dollar_tooltip: This will increase our liquid reserves, boosting our economy. The amount received will depend upon the level of reform we are willing to undertake.
strings.GER_the_red_telephone_tooltip: By establishing this connection, new options may become available during global flashpoints.
strings.GER_intelligence_sharing_tooltip:
If co-operation between our intelligence services can be achieved, we will unlock decryption bonuses against members of the Co-Prosperity Sphere.
It may prove extremely difficult to get the CIA and Abwehr to work together.
strings.GER_the_trojan_horse_tooltip:
We will send Reichsminister Speer on a state visit to the United States of America.
Should this visit go badly, it could have far reaching repercussions.
strings.GER_the_bormann_proposal_tooltip: We will follow the proposal of Martin Bormann for improving our relations with the OFN. This will greatly increase Bormann's influence within our government.
strings.GER_joint_propaganda_efforts_tooltip: Completing this focus will unlock a new set of decisions for raising war support for nations within the Einheitspakt and OFN.
strings.GER_spy_exchanges_tooltip: Alongside boosting our intelligence capabilities by recovering veteran agents, we may also gain insight into OFN activities from recovered agents.
strings.GER_recognize_pacific_claims_tooltip: The United States of America will gain claims on a number of Pacific islands, and relations between our two nations will improve.
strings.GER_recognize_pacific_claims_tooltip_2: The Japanese Empire may react very poorly to this.
strings.GER_spheres_of_influence_tooltip:
Completing this focus will significantly decrease the potential for flashpoints between the OFN and Einheitspakt.
Should we violate each others spheres in the future, this may lead to catastrophic results.
strings.GER_a_stranger_in_a_strange_land_tooltip:
We will send Parteiminister Bormann on a state visit to the United States of America.
Should this visit go badly, it could have far reaching repercussions.
strings.GER_convene_the_reichstag_tooltip: By formally opening the 1962 session of the Reichstag, we will be able to receive petitions from across the Reich and begin to address policy, reforms and national campaigns.
strings.GER_approve_the_budget_tooltip: Many groups within the Reich will react to the portion of the budget we assign them. Whilst we will gain the support of some, we will surely end up angering multiple groups.
strings.GER_guide_the_party_tooltip:
By dictating to the Party the correct stance on matters soon to be put before the Reichstag, we will have a chance to ensure that our desired policy for this year is enacted.
If we wait too long after convening the 1962 Reichstag without guiding the Party, it may result in unexpected consequences.
strings.GER_a_bridge_too_far_tooltip: If we do not resolve the protestor crisis soon, we may lose total control of the situation and face severe consequences.
strings.GER_a_war_of_attrition_tooltip: Whilst it will not resolve the crisis quickly, if we simply wait out the protests we may be able to avoid the situation devolving into bloodshed and international condemnation.
strings.GER_expand_the_orpo_tooltip: Whilst there will be a significant cost to recruit, train and equip a large increase of OrPo numbers nation wide, it will hopefully allow us to exert greater control should future domestic crises occur.
strings.GER_send_in_heydrich_tooltip: Proving themselves evermore to be no better than the degenerate partisans plaguing the Reich, we will deploy the SS to disperse the student protestors once and for all.
strings.GER_ss_scapegoats_tooltip: By shifting the blame onto the SS, we may be able to divert some of the domestic and international outrage directed toward our government, as well as force out several leading SS members.
strings.GER_ss_scapegoats_tooltip_2: This will greatly anger the SS.
strings.GER_pakt_wargames_tooltip: Completing this focus will unlock a new set of decisions for improving the military standing of Germany, the Reichskommissariats and our Pakt allies.
strings.GER_reinforce_the_east_tooltip: We will begin a program of reinforcing our eastern positions to counter the threat of a potentially resurgent Russia in the future.
strings.GER_refocus_the_bombings_tooltip: Completing this focus will remove the 'Terror Bombing' national spirit from several Russian warlords, but increase its effect against those warlords we continue to target.
strings.GER_the_kasche_question_tooltip: We will have the opportunity to remove and replace Siegfried Kasche as Ambassador to Sweden with a more loyal son of the Reich, should we deem it necessary to remove him at all.
strings.GER_ss_border_guards_tooltip:
We will force a redeployment of forces within Reichskommissariat Moskowien to decrease the threat from Russian raiders and partisans in the region.
This may result in the SS increasing their influence and power over the regime within Moskowien.
strings.GER_the_southern_threat_tooltip: We will begin detailed preparations directed toward ensuring we are fully able to commit to a total war against the Triumvirate should the tension between our two blocs spiral out of control.
strings.GER_the_balkan_bulwark_tooltip: Crucial in planning any invasion of Turkey or Italy, completing this focus will unlock a new set of decisions for fortifying both our influence and military position within the Balkans.
strings.GER_expand_the_gebirgsjager_tooltip: With the threat posed to our forces by an invasion of Italy via the Alps, developing our mountaineer forces will be crucial to our success.
strings.GER_find_their_lepidus_tooltip:
Completing this focus will allow us to target one of the Triumvirate pillar nations in an attempt to subvert or even break apart their alliance.
If we are detected doing this, it may lead to serious consequences.
strings.GER_the_eternal_enigma_tooltip: Our greatest weapon during both the Second World War and West Russian War, we must ensure that our military encryption can remain the envy of the world in the modern age.
strings.GER_economic_reform_tooltip: The Reich's economy surely shall benefit from this...
strings.GER_GCW_secure_bohemia_tt: We will ensure that Bohemia remains under our control should anything disastrous happen.
strings.GER_GCW_start_uprisings_tt: 2 loyal militia units will rise up
strings.GER_weapons_to_the_loyalists_tooltip: Suppling weapons to our loyal divisions will assure us a position of strength if the political situation becomes unmanageable
strings.GER_contacts_in_the_waffen_tooltip: Bribing the Waffen-SS will assure us that some of their elements will be loyal to us when the powder keg explodes
strings.GER_power_struggle_category_desc:
In the aftermath of the recent assassination attempt on the Führer's life, he has seen fit to name his official successor and designate upon him the matters of state that he, in his age, cannot perform. As the Führer's condition worsens, it is almost assured that the responsibilities of his most high office will pass more and more to his successor.

Yet, Hitler's chosen is not alone. Three other men vie for the power of the Führer, and their webs of influence have been spun far and deep. The German People may not know it, but within the halls of the Volkshalle, a silent war for the future of Germany rages. Victory in this conflict may bring advantages were the situation to further deteriorate. Influence points may be spent on several buffs for our faction. However, it would be unwise to spend it all at once as our remaining Influence points could affect our starting position, if the worst comes to the worst...

Adolf Hitler is currently {root_gethitlerhealth}

Martin Bormann's influence is currently {root_getbormanninfluence} ([?GER_Bormann_Influence|Y0])

Hermann Göring's influence is currently {root_getgoringinfluence} ([?GER_Goring_Influence|Y0])

Albert Speer's influence is currently {root_getspeerinfluence} ([?GER_Speer_Influence|Y0])

Reinhard Heydrich's influence is currently {root_getheydrichinfluence} ([?GER_Heydrich_Influence|Y0])

More Decisions will be available as Hitler's condition worsens.
strings.GER_GCW_look_for_opportunities_desc: It is said that if you want something done properly, you have to do it yourself. In the endless battle for legitimacy among the German people it is thus necessary to find any opportunity. Let's take a look, there will be “possibilities” if we just look hard enough.
strings.GER_GCW_build_up_prod_units_desc: By exploiting our leader's authority as Hitler's appointed heir, we can secure several large contracts with important civilian and military industries to prepare in case the worst happens.
strings.GER_GCW_build_up_forts_desc: The situation is quickly deteriorating, and it's only a matter of time before the gates of hell open. By ordering the construction of fortifications in zones where our control is strongest, we can gain enough time to organize our supporters in the coming struggle.
strings.GER_GCW_build_up_infantry_weapons_desc: With militias forming all throughout the Reich, we must ensure our supporters are better armed than all others. By using our leader's authority to divert military-grade supplies towards loyal regions, we can secure an important advantage should all other solutions fail.
strings.GER_GCW_build_up_heer_units: Bring Heer Regiments to Our Side
strings.GER_GCW_build_up_heer_units_desc: The army is steadily fracturing, officers and soldiers swearing their allegiance to the man rather than the Reich. With our leader's position as the legitimate heir to Hitler's legacy, we can leverage the support of several Heer regiments whose loyalty is still uncertain.
strings.GER_GCW_secure_bohemia_desc: We still hold sway over the vulnerable garrisons in Bohemia. By promising them our protection, we may quickly find this strategic outpost and its administrators on our side.
strings.GER_GCW_mechanic_category_desc:
The German Civil War is as much decided in the hearts and minds of the German people, as it is on the battlefield. The quest for legitimacy continues and so does the influence we can exert on areas controlled by the contenders linger. Keeping and gaining them may just be the edge needed to win the battle for the Reich's future.

We currently have [?GCW_legitimacy|Y0] Legitimacy.
({root_getgcwlegitimacylevel})
We currently have [?GCW_influence|Y0] Influence.
strings.GER_GCW_show_hide_influence_opportunitie: Toggles visibility of available influence opportunities.
strings.GER_GCW_show_hide_influence_actions_desc: Toggles visibility of available influence actions.
strings.GER_GCW_sabotage_frontlines_desc: With the outbreak of war, German lands have been fractured and split between by various forces vying for power. If we are to come out on top of this conflict, we must utilize any means possible to overwhelm our enemy. A covert operation to harass and disrupt the frontline of the enemy could prove to be the tactical maneuver needed to turn the tide of battle.
strings.GER_GCW_disrupt_supply_lines_desc: The supply lines of our enemy provide our foes with guns, rations, and ammunition on a daily basis. If we are to gain the upperhand in this conflict, we must sever the supply lines of the enemy and extinguish their fighting spirit.
strings.GER_GCW_start_uprisings_desc: There are brave men loyal to us trapped behind enemy lines, waiting for a chance to rise up and rebel against the common enemy. We should look into supplying and contacting these forces in order to gain a strategic advantage over our foes and assert our hegemony over Germany.
strings.GER_a_man_on_the_moon_desc: This is our moment, the culmination of decades of tiresome research and continuous advancement. Headed by the brilliant Prof. Dr. Wernher Freiherr von Braun, the German Aerospace Center is ready to commence its greatest operation to date: landing the first man on the moon. If successful, it will become the Reich's greatest scientific achievement since the weaponization of the Atom. The 'Space Race' is to now come to an end, with the dominant will of National-Socialism soon to triumph over the degenerate Americans and backwards Japanese once again. Heil Hitler!
strings.GER_the_enemy_of_my_enemy_desc: Despite our rather lucrative partnership during the Second World War, our diplomatic relations with the Japanese Empire have since become significantly more frosty. As we battle for dominance in the East, it is perhaps time to warm our relations with a certain former enemy who despise the Japanese even more than we do: the United States of America. Despite our opposed political philosophies and troubled past, if we can warm our relations together we may be able to contain the Samurai and ensure the fall of the Rising Sun.
strings.GER_the_speer_proposal_desc: As Reich Minister for Economics, Albert Speer is the single highest authority on the issue of the Großgermanisches Reich's economic situation. With the Führer's mark of confidence, Herr Speer has gained considerable influence within the NSDAP, now being able to influence German domestic and foreign policy decisions. Given this influence, Reichsminister Speer has proposed a new easing of trade and diplomatic relations with the United States in order to successfully counter the influence of the Japanese Empire.
strings.GER_ease_the_embargoes_desc: Regrettably, the Großgermanisches Reich and Einheitspakt is currently under a trade embargo from the United States and their Organization of Free Nations (OFN). However, with the adoption of Reichsminister Speer's proposal, this may hopefully change soon. In accordance with Speer's proposal, it's time we extend an olive branch to the U.S. Government to arrange talks aimed at the easing of trade restrictions on certain goods between the OFN and Pakt. If we are successful in our attempts, the projected increase in trade will hopefully boost the Reich's desperate economy.
strings.GER_the_almighty_dollar_desc: With our own currency, the Reichsmark, being in an astonishingly weak position when compared to that of the U.S. Dollar on the international exchange, Reichsminister Speer has implored the government to enact drastic reform to our draconian foreign currency policies. With our own foreign currency reserves shambolic, enacting reform and easing restrictions will hopefully boost our international economic position and foster improved economic relations with the U.S. in the process.
strings.GER_the_red_telephone_desc: With the recent 'détente' in German-American relations, it's best we aim to maintain these gains no matter what may occur. Given the history of conflict and aggression between our two nations, it's been suggested that the establishment of a Germania-Washington hotline would be beneficial for both partners, allowing for direct communication between the Führer and President in times of crisis. A direct link between our two nations which may be key in preventing a terrible escalation between our nations, and to ensuring the very survival of mankind itself.
strings.GER_intelligence_sharing_desc: To further our new cooperative relationship with our transatlantic brethren, it's perhaps time to propose a rather radical concept - intelligence sharing. Although both the German and American intelligence services are mired in obscurity and competition, it's best we punch a hole through said obstacles and work toward improved cooperation against the Japanese Empire. For we will both be able to more effectively fight the growing influence of Japan if we are prepared to share sensitive information on their activities.
strings.GER_the_trojan_horse_desc: With the improvement in German-American relations being watched closely across the world, the citizens of the United States and Reich alike hold their breath in the hope that this 'détente' will eventually result in the achievement of friendship between the traditionally cold Superpowers. As the world watches, we will now launch our most groundbreaking diplomatic move yet. Already endeared to the Americans who view him as their friend within the Reich, we will send Reichsminister Albert Speer to conduct a state visit to the United States on behalf of the Führer. Unthinkable five years ago, the turning of the tide in the Cold War will be clear for all to see, especially the Japanese Empire.
strings.GER_the_bormann_proposal_desc: As Parteiminister, Martin Bormann wields an astonishing amount of power within the Reich. With the Führer's support, Herr Bormann has risen to become the undisputed leader of the NSDAP, able to greatly influence German domestic and foreign policy decisions. Given this influence, Parteiminister Bormann has offered the government his proposal advocating for increased cooperation and the achievement of a proper understanding with the United States in order to successfully counter the influence of the Japanese Empire.
strings.GER_joint_propaganda_efforts_desc: It's evident to Herr Bormann that the seemingly ever continuing propaganda war between the Großgermanisches Reich and the United States is detrimental to any attempt at forging a cooperative-alliance against the Japanese Empire. It has thus been suggested that perhaps if the U.S. and Germany were to partake in a joint propaganda operation against the Japanese Empire it would greatly damage their ability to gain further global influence. For if we are to unite against Japan, we must have a unified voice to the rest of the world about their evil.
strings.GER_spy_exchanges_desc: Engaging in a Cold War, the rise in espionage and subversive acts between the Reich and the U.S. was only natural. As we now seek to further our newfound 'détente' with the United States, Herr Bormann has suggested we increase relations between our intelligence communities behind the scenes as well as our more public efforts. With both sides holding dozens of each other's citizens detained for espionage, the time has now come to propose Spy Exchanges to bring both of our people home while relations remain warm enough to allow it.
strings.GER_recognize_pacific_claims_desc: It's clear to us that the only way to truly gain the trust and confidence of the U.S. Government is to formally recognize their claims to regions of the Pacific which they lost to Japan during the Second World War. By officially acknowledging said claims, it will (hopefully) pave the way for the swift betterment of ties between our two nations and make our stance regarding Japan clear. For the United States and the Großgermanisches Reich have no choice but to stand side-by-side against the great evil of the Japanese Empire.
strings.GER_spheres_of_influence_desc: A key, yet highly classified, element of Herr Bormann's proposal is now ready to begin. In a secret high level conference with our new transatlantic friends, we shall divide the world into formal spheres of influence. By doing so we can hopefully drastically reduce the potential for future flashpoints between our two nations by staying within our assigned global areas of influence, and put greater focus on containing Japan. Whilst there will surely be times in the future where we will inevitably fail to respect each other's spheres, it remains a significant step towards ensuring peace between our nations.
strings.GER_a_stranger_in_a_strange_land: A Stranger in a Strange Land
strings.GER_a_stranger_in_a_strange_land_desc: With the improvement in German-American relations being watched closely across the world, the citizens of the United States and Reich alike hold their breath in the hope that this 'détente' will eventually result in the achievement of friendship between the traditionally cold Superpowers. As the world watches, we will now launch our most groundbreaking diplomatic move yet. As the most powerful man in the Reich aside from the Führer himself, by sending Martin Bormann on a state visit to the United States on behalf of the Führer we will show our sincerity toward maintaining warm relations between our two superpowers.
strings.GER_convene_the_reichstag_desc: Today we mark another milestone in the history of the Großgermanisches Reich, the opening of the 1962 Reichstag. A grand ceremony, the annual opening of a Reichstag has become one of the most lavish affairs across the entire Einheitspakt with delegations of subjugated peoples' coming from all across our vast empire to gather in Germania to hear the Führer address the NSDAP as we celebrate yet another glorious year. Needless to say, the opening of the 1962 Reichstag will be the grandest yet!
strings.GER_approve_the_budget_desc: Although over the past decade the Großgermanisches Reich regrettably experienced certain financial difficulties, our economic problems are now mostly stable and the allocation of finances toward a Reich-whole budget is somewhat of a simple if monotonous affair for the Diet. Yet, it is something that must be done if the Reich is to survive at least another year, let alone the Führer's prophesied 1,000 years.
strings.GER_guide_the_party_desc: To truly maintain political stability in the Großgermanisches Reich, we cannot allow for the accidental splintering of the Diet into factionalism. Therefore (like always), we have no choice but to guide our Party Comrades within the Diet on how to vote, and what the acceptable stance is, on upcoming issues which are to be put before the Reichstag. For the pursuit of ideals other than that sanctioned by the will of the Führer and Party is treasonous and destabilizing to the Fatherland.
strings.GER_a_bridge_too_far_desc: Whilst the Fatherland has been plagued by the protesting youth for months, the protests are now getting out of hand. Now beginning to occupy major bridges across Germany and in the capital, they are causing mass disruption on a new scale and enough is enough. The time has come to decide what must happen to these rogue elements of society who desire nothing but to bring about instability and degeneracy within our borders.
strings.GER_a_war_of_attrition_desc: Given how it would more than likely send a bad message to the world if the streets of the Reich were to run red with the blood of the next generation of 'true believers', it's best we play a proverbial 'war of attrition' with the student protests. By continuing to simply wait them out, like every new generation filled with the rebelliousness of youth, they'll simply bore themselves out and return to their dorm rooms, moving on to their adult lives in the service of the Fatherland and Führer. As has been the case thus far and will be forevermore.
strings.GER_expand_the_orpo_desc: Whilst we have the protests contained, we have still learned lessons from the experience which must be heeded. In order to avoid bloodshed and potential revolution from disloyal and agitated young people, both today and in the future, it's best we invest in expanding the Ordnungspolizei (Orpo), the uniformed police force. By better establishing the police forces of the Reich to efficiently and effectively put down any future hostile actions from the disaffected student class, we can ensure future stability and remove any calls to hand over such responsibilities to the Heer or the SS.
strings.GER_send_in_heydrich_desc: It is clear to our government that the student protestors pose a very real threat to our internal stability and the standing of the Reich on the world stage, and so the time has come to put an end to it once and for all. Occupying major cities, attacking Party offices, assaulting Orpo officers, causing mass disruption the protestors have proved themselves little different to the partisans who fight us across the Reich. If this is how they wish to act, then we must respond in kind. The time has come to declare them what they are and send in our specialists for dispersing partisan activities: Deputy Reichsführer-SS Heydrich and his Schutzstaffel.
strings.GER_ss_scapegoats_desc: Whilst the SS have dispersed the protests with the swiftness, efficiency, and brutality they are famed for, we are now left with the aftermath of streets running red with the blood of Germany's youth. With many domestically and internationally looking for someone to blame, we can ensure that the responsibility falls upon the shoulders of the SS. By invoking well crafted paperwork and coerced testimony, we can direct the blame onto overzealous SS officers who overstepped their orders. Whilst it will alleviate pressure from the government, and allow us to force several SS figures into an early retirement, it is unlikely that Heydrich will react well to the move.
strings.GER_pakt_wargames_desc: Although the Cold War is, well, cold, the threat of a 'Hot War' is not lost upon the upper echelons of the Großgermanisches Reich and thus we must be ready for armed conflict at a moment's notice. Therefore, the Pakt Wargames are our answer to keeping Europe prepared for a new, major conflict with our enemies. These military exercises are designed to be vast in its scope, with on average over one million soldiers from across the Pakt partaking in these intensive Wargames, helping strengthen the brotherhood and comradeship between the Großgermanisches Reich and her allies whilst sending a strong message to the wider world.
strings.GER_reinforce_the_east_desc: The East, both our greatest accomplishment and our greatest failure. We may have crushed the Soviet bear in Operation Barbarossa, but the bear bit back to force us away from the A-A line a mere decade later. Since the disaster of the West Russian War, our eastern Reichskommissariats, namely Moskowien, have suffered tremendously at the hands of degenerate raiders who plunge into the borders of the Reich, slaughtering settlers and pillaging their homes for what little loot they can find. It's evident to the Führer that the East at this time is the area of greatest strategic importance to the Reich, and must be strengthened against continued Russian aggression.
strings.GER_refocus_the_bombings_desc: The Luftwaffe, for all its glory, has through sheer incompetence been left carpet bombing randomly selected Russian targets over the last decade, often of little strategic or tactical significance. Instead of continuing to waste valuable munitions on generally unimportant targets for little gain, we must force the Luftwaffe to adopt a new strategy of strategic bombings, namely against the West Russian Revolutionary Front. By refocusing our airpower to more suitable targets, we may yet move toward permanently entrenching our as of yet uncertain position in the East.
strings.GER_the_kasche_question_desc:
Siegfried Kasche, a liability if there ever was one. After the war, there was little need for his brutish incompetence, leading to calls for his replacement as Reichskommissar of Moskowien. Fortunately for Kasche, Göring was there to cushion his fall by appointing him as the Reich's ambassador to Sweden, but this did not come without controversy.

Bormann and the other vultures circling around the throne have repeatedly criticized Kasche's diplomatic work in Sweden as “minimal”, to put it lightly. With Sweden continuing to keep its distance from us, perhaps they are right. We will give Kasche a post more fitting for his rudimentary abilities and find someone else more capable for the job.
strings.GER_ss_border_guards_desc: The eastern Moskowien border is, without a doubt, one of the most dangerous postings within the entire Reich. The terrain is vast and rough, terrible snow storms and crippling mud assaulting our divisions alongside constant attacks across the border from raiders and Soviet partisans. To be frank, conditions on the front are horrifying, and the existing border guard has proven barely capable of the task. As such, a new proposal has been put forward by elements of the Heer suggesting that the SS should take a greater role in securing the border. As our specialist anti-partisan forces, there is surely no place in the Reich they are more suited to be deployed than such an unstable region. If, in doing so, SS casualties happen to begin replacing those of our young German soldiers, we shall not shed any tears.
strings.GER_the_southern_threat_desc: Southern Europe, our greatest diplomatic failure. Although German-Italian military cooperation resulted in our stunning victory over the seemingly unshakable empires of Britain and France, relations between our nation and the Kingdom of Italy have since collapsed. The traitor Mussolini stabbed our beloved Führer in the back, abandoning the Pakt and welcomed thousands of degenerate undesirables into Italy to escape us. Having since formed their Triumvirate alliance with the Iberian Union and Turkey, the situation to the south poses the primary anti-German threat on the continent. With the Soviet threat crushed in the east during the West Russian War, our focus must now begin to prepare against the southern threat.
strings.GER_the_balkan_bulwark_desc: Though the dastardly Italians may have stolen Croatia from our grasp, the Fatherland thankfully still holds Serbia and Bulgaria under its influence, with both nations being supportive and enthusiastic members of the Pakt. However, our interests in the Balkans must be secured beyond all measure of doubt, combatting Italian and Turkish influence in the region at every turn to ensure that the route through the Balkans remains open in the event of a war with the Triumvirate - this must be our utmost priority in the region.
strings.GER_expand_the_gebirgsjager_desc: The Gebirgsjäger, Germany's elite alpine troops, will become crucial in the event of a German-Italian conflict at our southern frontier. The harshest fighting is sure to occur through the Alps, a campaign sure to be grueling and to which our armies will be at a disadvantage throughout. In preparation for such an eventuality, the Oberkommando der Wehrmacht has proposed a drastic increase in the size of our prestigious mountain elites, knowing they will prove invaluable in such a conflict.
strings.GER_find_their_lepidus_desc: Although on the surface the Triumvirate appears a united and undeniably powerful European diplomatic and military bloc, the true reality is its inner mantle is rotten to the core. Through our diplomatic and intelligence channels, it is clear to us that the Triumvirate nations all hold grievances and dissatisfactions against each other. It is only natural then that one of the three powers must feel pushed to the way-side by their larger and more influential partners. We need only pinpoint who it is, and then exploit their unhappiness to our complete advantage.
strings.GER_the_eternal_enigma_desc: During the Second World War, Germany's top engineers developed the Enigma machine, our legendary encryption device, along with the unbroken military code which came with it. Due to its success and uncompromised status, the machine is still regularly used to this day operating across all branches of the Wehrmacht. However, the current machinery is now extremely outdated and new computing software has developed to the point to which the Enigma machine is now growing obsolete. It is therefore time to develop a new, even better Enigma to keep our secrets safe in the modern age.
strings.GER_bormann_desc: With the Führer's proclamation of Parteiminister Martin Bormann as successor the vast majority of German citizens are hopeful of a stable future for the Reich. Herr Bormann, a staunch conservative, is by far the least controversial choice and has gained a remarkably significant amount of support from both the Party and citizenry alike, who largely believe that only through the adoption of a far more conservative ethos can the Reich and its National Socialist ideology survive.
strings.GER_Bormann_chosen:
Zum letzten Mal wird Sturmalarm geblasen!
Zum Kampfe steh'n wir alle schon bereit!
Schon flattern Hitlerfahnen über allen Straßen.
Die Knechtschaft dauert nur noch kurze Zeit!
strings.GER_present_the_alternative_desc:
Unlike his opponents, Parteiminister Bormann is largely viewed as a pragmatic National Socialist, someone who is both staunchly conservative yet able to see reason, and is able to negotiate with the more reformist elements in our society rather than simply dispersing and breaking up the opposition.

Herr Bormann is first and foremost a National Socialist, through and through, but he is a pragmatic man. He is no fool, and is able to work with men from nearly all aspects of German society; a far cry from the other contenders...
strings.GER_secure_the_party_desc: To successfully govern the Großgermanisches Reich one must first conquer the National Socialist German Workers' Party, which is key in securing the apparatus of state. If Hitler is the head of the NSDAP, as Parteiminister Bormann is its proverbial brain. However despite his major influence in the party his political opponents continue to challenge Bormann within the Party, something which the Parteiminister must resolve if he is to successfully unite the NSDAP.
strings.GER_expose_speers_hypocrisy_desc: In recent years the Führer's close friend and Reichsminister of Economics, Albert Speer, has become the main proponent of reform in the NSDAP. Yet Speer himself is quite possibly the most prolific liar and hypocrite within the borders of the Großgermanisches Reich. Having served as Reichsminister of Armaments and War Production during the Second World War, he introduced the very system of the 'Slave Economy' which he claims to despise despite being its proverbial 'Founding Father'. It's about time both the party and public be informed of who was truly behind the German 'Slave Economy'.
strings.GER_remind_them_of_heydrichs_bloodlust_d: The 'Blonde Beast' yearns for violence and blood; it is simply what he lives for. As Himmler's 'protégé', Deputy Reichsführer-SS Reinhard Heydrich is the leader of the German branch of the feared Schutzstaffel (SS). During the Second World War, Herr Heydrich more than earned his reputation; that of a psychopathic butcher of men, women and children. We have a moral duty to remind the party and people of Heydrich's insatiable bloodlust and blatant disregard for human life. Under his leadership, the Reich would more resemble a massive 'Death Factory' than a global superpower!
strings.GER_challenge_gorings_competence_desc: Hermann Göring - President of the Reichstag, Supreme Commander of the Luftwaffe and the Reichsmarschall of Germany. A typical plutocrat, Göring's concerns lie with his immense wealth and status rather than that of the struggles of the average citizen, despite what the medal-strewn 'man of the people' happens to claim. Behind all his boasting and showmanship, is Herr Göring truly fit to rule a nation? By his own admission he knows nothing of economics, nor has he expressed much interest in his political duties, choosing rather to grow his vast array of treasures. It's time we break the public perception of Göring being a competent politician.
strings.GER_the_greatest_threat_is_indecisivenes: Despite the political polarization of the masses in recent years, many officials both within the NSDAP and the Reichstag have yet to formally pick a side in this multifaceted conflict of policy and economics. Of course Herr Bormann isn't particularly fond of said neutral elements - he believes that indecisiveness among party officials is a sign of weakness which should be stamped out lest it weaken the Fatherland. If you don't pick a side, who knows who you might end up under?
strings.GER_blackmail_the_rest_desc: Those who are stubborn enough not to relent and pick a side in the war of words will learn to find loyalty in a candidate, the right candidate - that being Herr Bormann. As a result, we have the unfortunate yet rightful task of blackmailing these individuals within the party who are moronic enough to not realize that perhaps making an enemy of the Parteiminister - who is aware of all their dealings - isn't a particularly good idea. This will be incredibly useful in getting certain hesitant figures into Bormann's flock.
strings.GER_meet_with_the_generals_desc: In the run up to the Führer's proclamation, Herr Bormann received a considerable amount of support from large elements of the Wehrmacht who share similar conservative beliefs. Now that the Führer has wisely chosen the Parteiminister as his successor, it's time that Herr Bormann meets with the generals to solidify their support for him and his conservative National Socialist ethos.
strings.GER_increase_the_budget_desc: The Wehrmacht is primarily divided between the conservative Parteiminister Bormann and his hawkish counterpart Reichsmarschall Göring. To secure Bormann's support among the Wehrmacht at large, we must do everything possible to ensure the Wehrmacht will be kept happy in the run-up to Bormann's eventual coronation as Führer. Therefore we will authorize an increase in the Wehrmacht's annual budget to placate the organization.
strings.GER_expand_rd_desc: To further secure the support of the Wehrmacht for Parteiminister Bormann rather than Reichsmarschall Göring, we must show that under the leadership of Bormann the Wehrmacht will truly flourish. As a result, we have no choice but to expand the Army Weapons Office, granting it far more resources than previously allocated. This act will hopefully raise the loyalty of the Wehrmacht to the pragmatic cause of Parteiminister Bormann and discourage support for the Reichsmarschall's hawkish clique.
strings.GER_ground_the_luftwaffe_desc: Many of those who make up the upper echelons of the Heer and Kriegsmarine have a considerable amount of personal disdain for Reichsmarschall Göring and his precious Luftwaffe which has unfairly absorbed a greater portion of the budget in recent decades than its contemporaries. Therefore to truly show the Heer and Kriegsmarine that Herr Bormann favors them, we shall punish Göring's glorious Luftwaffe by clipping its wings.
strings.GER_friends_in_the_kriegsmarine_desc: Unlike his contemporaries in the party, Herr Bormann has received a great deal of support from officers and sailors of the Kriegsmarine - including the endorsement of Großadmiral Karl Dönitz. This support would be highly useful to Herr Bormann when attempting to secure the Reich if the unthinkable were to occur following the Führer's eventual passing. It's best we build upon our friendships with the Kriegsmarine and its officers.
strings.GER_utilize_hitler_desc: To truly obtain the support of the Wehrmacht and German citizenry, it's time we utilize our most powerful weapon - the Führer himself. Unlike his opponents, Parteiminister Bormann was blessed with the Führer's endorsement as successor. Therefore it can be argued that those who dare oppose Herr Bormann are acting in direct opposition to the wishes of the Führer - of course, that isn't tolerable. We will make it clear that all who question Bormann's legitimacy are in fact questioning the Führer himself. And you wouldn't want to do that, would you?
strings.GER_friends_in_all_the_places: Friends in All the Right Places
strings.GER_friends_in_all_the_places_desc: Unlike his opponents who have found themselves generally alienated from society, Herr Bormann has friends all across the Großgermanisches Reich and beyond. Of course, the more friends the better, and we will use this to our advantage. The time has come to call upon the many friends and allies of the Parteiminister to come to his aid and voice their public support for his agenda.
strings.GER_the_american_ambassador_desc: Although many in the United States lean more towards supporting Albert Speer and his reformist agenda, we must attempt to convince the Americans that Parteiminister Bormann is in fact the better option for the Großgermanisches Reich than Herr Speer. How will we accomplish this? Simple! We will convince the American Ambassador to the Reich that Herr Bormann is indeed better for stability than Speer and attempt to discourage public support from within the government for his movement - how difficult could it possibly be!?
strings.GER_the_reichkommissars_desc: As Parteiminister, Herr Bormann has received considerable support from the majority of the Reichskommissars who view him as the one man who could potentially keep the Reich together in these trying times. As a result of their immense influence on the affairs of the Großgermanisches Reich, it's time we call upon their support when attempting to help Bormann establish his dominance over the nation in the event of the Führer's inevitable passing.
strings.GER_the_mercenaries_desc: The issue of the loyalty of the Waffen-SS is one of great complexity. In recent years, the loyalty of certain divisions has been called into question. There is no denying that the Waffen-SS is an elite fighting force, in some respects of better quality than certain Heer divisions. As a result, we will attempt to bribe certain division commanders who have begun offering their services in a somewhat 'mercenary' style. We have no choice but to buy their loyalty, as they may be extremely useful to our cause.
strings.GER_goring_desc: With the Führer's proclamation of Reichsmarschall Hermann Göring as successor a significant amount of German citizens are optimistic that the Reich will be restored to greatness. Among the population 'Uncle Göring', as he is affectionately called, is extremely popular and is generally regarded as quite the 'man of the people'. Göring himself is somewhat of a political conservative, yet his brand of National Socialist conservatism is one of general re-militarization and conquest, all designed to reinvigorate the Reich's economy and global dominance.
strings.GER_send_in_the_heer_desc: With the student protests intensifying over the past few weeks over the appointment of Reichsmarschall Hermann Göring as the Führer's successor, the time has come to show that in Göring's Germany dissent will not be tolerated. Unlike his opponents, the Reichsmarschall is not afraid to do what must be done. Therefore it's been decided that the only way to end the protests is to send in the Heer to silence the many voices of discontent who seek to destabilize the Reich with their reformist dogma.
strings.GER_go_before_the_reichstag_desc: As President of the Reichstag, Herr Göring holds considerable influence within the Diet. Due to said influence, the militaristic hawks of the NSDAP have begun to gain more legislative power in recent weeks, much to the dismay of the more moderate figures within the Diet. As a result, the Reichsmarschall himself will go before the Reichstag and make a passionate and grandiose speech to rally support for the militarist cause and calm down opposition from other Diet representatives.
strings.GER_roar_on_the_radio_desc: The now deceased Reichsminister of Public Enlightenment and Propaganda, Dr. Joseph Goebbels once stated that the radio was the greatest propaganda asset ever devised - encouraging the industries' growth at the outset of our regime. Although Goebbels is unfortunately no longer with us, we shall take a page from his book and use methods of radio to solidify our influence over the public. We will roar on the radio till every single German is united behind our agenda of warfare, glory and national redemption.
strings.GER_dominate_on_television_desc: Long ago, the Reich's various propaganda outlets had seemingly been won over by Herr Göring, producing pieces which helped strengthen his popularity among Germans and solidifying his 'man of the people' image. Yet, despite the tumultuous nature of the Reich over the past decade the press have largely remained loyal to the Reichsmarschall and the Wehrmacht's hawks. Due to this good relationship, we shall abuse this proverbial friendship to dominate the Reich's television networks to attempt to convince the people of our inspiring message and well meaning beliefs.
strings.GER_smile_for_the_cameras_desc: To get the German citizenry behind our message of militarization we must appear optimistic for the future. At the outset of our regime three decades ago many Germans, left in a cynical state following the trauma of the previous decade, had to be reminded of the glories of being a German and the need for optimism, which Dr. Goebbels's 'happy-go-lucky' propaganda helped quench. Like our propaganda success decades prior, by smiling for the cameras and presenting an attitude of positivity and hope we will unite the Fatherland once more and quell worries of the future.
strings.GER_dine_with_high_society_desc: Despite his seemingly populistic ethos, being regarded as a 'man of the people' by most German citizens, Reichsmarschall Göring has found considerable support from the aristocratic elements of society in the Großgermanisches Reich. Although the various aristocratic cliques have seemingly scored a major political victory with the Führer's succession announcement, their support is not completely solid as of yet. Therefore the Reichsmarschall has no choice but to dine with society's elite, making extravagant promises and wooing the aristocrats into unequivocal support.
strings.GER_the_biggest_parade_yet_desc: Given our increasingly militaristic agenda it only makes sense to put the might of the Wehrmacht on display for the globe. Now, how do we plan on doing this? Through a parade of course, a ginormous parade through the streets of Germania. Hopefully holding the biggest parade in German history will spill over into nationalistic fervor and a longing to see the Reich reclaim its rightful glory whilst worrying out opponents. We're absolutely sure of it!
strings.GER_secure_the_streets_desc: With the Führer's proclamation of Reichsmarschall Göring as his successor, we have been handed the Führer's permission to secure the streets of the Großgermanisches Reich for Herr Göring's supporters in preparation of incoming inevitability of his (the Führer's) passing. Therefore, we shall commence the retaking of the Reich's streets by our hawkish establishment clique.
strings.GER_supply_loyal_divisions_desc: In the incoming struggle for governance over the Großgermanisches Reich, it will be the most equipped and well-prepared who will ultimately achieve the apparatus of state. Continuing with this seemingly Social Darwinist philosophy, we have no choice but to play favorites with regard to the allocation of supply in the Heer. By conducting this change in supply to favor the hawks, we will almost certainly damage the potential capability of our political opponents who hold ideological favor with certain Heer divisions.
strings.GER_tour_the_panzer_fleet_desc: The Panzer fleet of the Großgermanisches Reich is a brilliant symbol of national pride - a constant reminder of our military prowess. Therefore, it's only proper that Reichsmarschall Göring partakes in a potentially valuable propaganda piece which may sway as of yet undecided Panzer commanders. Herr Göring will thereby tour the nation's Panzer fleet in order to drum up support in the Wehrmacht for his militaristic agenda.
strings.GER_bolster_the_luftwaffe_desc: As Supreme Commander of the Luftwaffe, Reichsmarschall Göring's agenda of increased militarization will surely affect his pride and joy. As a result of said agenda, Herr Göring has proclaimed that the Luftwaffe is to be bolstered through every available means. Although the majority of the Luftwaffe High Command is pleased with this announcement, many in the Heer and Kriegsmarine are quite displeased over this clear display of favoritism. Yet, who are we to deny the Reichsmarschall of his wishes?
strings.GER_approach_the_waffen_desc: With the Waffen-SS having been exposed to degenerate ideals, many division commanders have since embraced corrupt activities as a means of making greater amounts of Reichsmarks a year. Despite how morally abhorrent such actions are, these corrupt officers may be quite useful to us. Given how the Waffen-SS is still regarded as the 'elite' of the German Armed Forces, we can simply bribe the commanders of said divisions to remain loyal to our goals and help enforce the legitimacy of Reichsmarschall Göring as the Führer's successor upon those who may think otherwise.
strings.GER_train_all_day_every_day_desc: To ensure that the Wehrmacht is in top physical shape in the unfortunate event of an armed conflict over who the next Führer shall be. Therefore we shall implement a policy of continuous training, as we must ensure our Wehrmacht is ready for a conflict at a moments notice! This will serve to increase public confidence in the capability and preparedness of the Wehrmacht as well as show our enemies that we are willing and ready to fight if need be.
strings.GER_making_our_move_desc: Although we have seemingly been successful in establishing Reichsmarschall Göring as the Führer's rightful successor among public and military opinion, there are still those who are foolish and stubborn enough to continue to challenge Herr Göring and the Führer's judgement. The time has come, we shall make our move on these hostile elements for the safety and security of the Großgermanisches Reich. We will and must be brutal - for it is either ours or their lives.
strings.GER_crush_the_liberals_desc: The student-led reformist elements of society continue to cause a great deal of trouble for the Großgermanisches Reich at large. Under the leftist influence of Reichsminister Speer - it's a constant fight with these protestors - who shall not relent in their deranged screeching till their mad reformist policies are implemented by the government. We have no choice but to unleash our men upon the student insurrectionary forces - as they actively threaten and compromise the stability and security of our Reich.
strings.GER_strangle_the_ss_desc: Himmler's sycophantic beast in Germania, Reichsführer-SS Heydrich - has continued to undermine the government since the outbreak of troubles in the early 1950s. Despite the seemingly unlimited power of the Schutzstaffel, their borderline treasonous actions must be halted without impunity. We have no choice but to strangle the SS, throwing them from their collapsing glass tower of secrecy and bureaucracy. In Göring's Reich, treachery is not a tolerable offense - everything will be uncovered!
strings.GER_invoke_hitlers_name_desc: With the Großgermanisches Reich quickly descending into utter chaos, it's obvious that the Fatherland will not find peace following the Führer's passing. Yet - there is still some glimmer of hope. To quell any questions of legitimacy once and for all, we will invoke the Führer's name - and once again remind the public that Reichsmarschall Göring is his legitimate successor. Let us hope our reminder perhaps puts a damper on the aspirations of others...
strings.GER_speer_desc: With the Führer's proclamation of Reichsminister Albert Speer as successor public opinion has been left divided, with many doubting Speer's abilities to govern whilst others are enthusiastic of potential change in the Reich. A highly controversial choice, Herr Speer has all but alienated himself from the upper echelons of the State through his strong advocation of reformist policies in the Reich designed to steer the troubled nation toward a possible prosperous future. Despite his close friendship with the Führer, this remains an uphill battle for the Architect of Germania.
strings.GER_reel_in_the_orpo_desc: With the student-led protests intensifying over the initial months of 1962, the Orpo is beginning to resort to more desperately aggressive acts of law enforcement as the students have become more violent and fierce. With the situation quickly descending into utter chaos, with a potentially fatal clash between the students and Orpo being more likely than ever - Herr Speer has ordered the Orpo be 'reeled in' - neutering its ability to combat the students.
strings.GER_embrace_the_students_desc: Given the Führer's appointment of Reichsminister Albert Speer as successor, it's only natural that we should attempt to pursue a more friendly policy toward the student protestors. Perhaps by wholeheartedly embracing the student movement it'll perhaps halt the increasingly violent protests that continuously disrupt our major cities? If not, at least it would show that the Führer is a pragmatist - which may endear us to the students.
strings.GER_appeal_to_the_reichstag_desc: In the past the German political establishment had all but exiled Speer from its ranks, given his appetite for reform within the Reich. However - given the Führer's recent proclamation of Speer's successorship, it's been suggested to the Reichsminister that he should perhaps attempt to convince the Diet once more that reform is indeed needed in the Reich. Herr Speer has no choice but to enter Bormann's fiefdom once more and desperately plead his case for reform. As without the Reichstag's support, how could Speer ever hope to govern the Großgermanisches Reich?
strings.GER_the_first_reform_desc: With the Reichstag seemingly onboard with the implementation of reform within the Großgermanisches Reich, the first reform is upon the people of the Reich! However, Herr Speer - knowing how important the first reform will be, as it will be what history remembers as the beginning of all to come, is still attempting to decide exactly what the commencement of such momentous legislative action should be. No doubt he'll eventually come up with something worthy of the title as the 'first'.
strings.GER_tour_the_nation_desc: Despite the Führer's endorsement of Herr Speer as his successor, he remains a deeply divisive figure within the Großgermanisches Reich - with many lambasting him as a political 'Judas' and traitor, whilst others proclaim him to be the Reich's only hope for a prosperous future. Through extreme polarization, the truth of the matter has become muddled in misconception in lies. To truly show the Fatherland of Herr Speer's friendly nature and pro-NSDAP attitude, we will send him on a grand tour across the Großgermanisches Reich to dismay any ridiculous fears.
strings.GER_approach_the_americans_desc: With the appointment of Herr Speer as the next Führer, a wave of optimistic fervor has swept across the international community - particularly within the government of the United States. Prior to the announcement, Speer took a seemingly pragmatic approach to foreign affairs - urging reconciliation and cooperation between nation-states. Keeping true to his previous utopian vision, we will reach out to the Americans and prepare the way for a potential future détente.
strings.GER_promise_a_future_desc: Unlike our opponents who seem to fervently cling to the decades old triumphs of the Großgermanisches Reich - Herr Speer urges we look toward the future, rather than continue to seek guidance from our previous exploits. He stands out as the only major political figure active in current Reich politics that has a pragmatic outlook on the future. Whilst our opponents may make extravagant claims of recapturing the magic of the 1930s and 40s, we will simply promise the Reich a future - and hopefully it will be a prosperous one, as the German people have suffered enough.
strings.GER_calm_down_the_wehrmacht_desc: With the Führer's bestowment upon Speer the soon-to-be vacant chalice of the Reich, many of the state's most cherished institutions have responded poorly to the news - the worst of which has come from the Wehrmacht. Given the Wehrmacht's traditionally conservative beliefs, it's unsurprising that the selection of a relative liberal (at least by our standards) has upset them greatly. In order to maintain order in the Reich, we must first calm down the Wehrmacht...
strings.GER_support_the_kriegsmarine_desc: As the majority of the Heer and Luftwaffe having shown nothing but disdain for Herr Speer, there's one element of the Wehrmacht which has shown an interesting level of support for Speer's agenda - the Kriegsmarine. Given how the organisation is already leaning more toward Herr Speer than the other political leaders of the Reich, it would be best if we were to build upon our decent relationship with the Kriegsmarine - seemingly rewarding them for their loyalty.
strings.GER_defund_the_luftwaffe_desc: For decades Reichsmarschall Göring has seemingly been Albert Speer's greatest rival, with the two continuously coming into conflict since the establishment of the Führer's regime three decades ago. Given Herr Speer's newfound influence - being the Führer's successor, he will of course target his greatest rival - for it is the survival of the fittest. It has been decided that to best check Göring's influence, you must neuter his pride and joy - the Luftwaffe. As a result we will defund the Luftwaffe, keeping them short of fuel and restricting the missions they can fly, which affect Göring's power. Yet this isn't purely personal, as cutting back the Luftwaffe budget is something that very much appeals to Speer due to his pragmatic economic strategy.
strings.GER_find_the_reformers_desc: Although the Wehrmacht is primarily split between Parteikanzler Bormann and Reichsmarschall Göring, with the majority of its talented officer pool being drawn to either party - there are still quite a few sympathetic to Herr Speer's ambitious reformist plans. However, these individuals aren't particularly vocal of their secret unquenchable appetite for reform. Therefore we have no choice but to carefully filter the officers of the Wehrmacht, identifying those who are sympathetic to our cause in the event of trouble following the Führer's passing.
strings.GER_restrict_ss_recruitment_desc: The Schutzstaffel, the most extreme adherents of National Socialist philosophy. Given the organization's largely radical beliefs, it's becoming a breeding ground of virulent anti-Speer sentiment in the Reich. Furthermore, given the actions undertaken by Reichsführer-SS Himmler and Heydrich in recent years - it's been suggested that SS recruitment should be restricted, with or without their consent. The SS's considerable hatred for Herr Speer has provided him with a legitimate casus-belli to enact said restrictions.
strings.GER_a_new_kind_of_war_desc: Although it's been decades since the end of 'traditional war' as it can be referred to, many generals and the Oberkommando der Wehrmacht seem to have failed to comprehend the change in situation. Seeing this rather old fashioned outlook as concerning, Herr Speer must convince the more traditionalist generals who still view the world through the lens of Social Darwinist militarism. We can still fight and win major conflicts without ever firing a shot, we simply need to convey that message to the generals.
strings.GER_a_sensible_economy_desc: In accordance with Speer's doctrine of reform, it's time to at least attempt to commence some level of economic reform in the Reich. Herr Speer has a great many gripes with the current economy of the Reich, referring to it as unstable and deeply unfair for the average German. With the enactment of his reforms, let us hope the Großgermanisches Reich will soon achieve economic stability and sensibility under the wise leadership of Speer.
strings.GER_opening_the_market_desc: The Großgermanisches Reich is currently under embargo by our opponents in the OFN and Co-Prosperity Sphere, though it's not as if we're entirely innocent, as we ourselves are currently embargoing several potentially profitable trade partners. Thus we have unintentionally limited Germany's capacity to engage in international trade - thereby causing us unneeded economic strain. To have a successful economy, we must lift our as of yet iron-clad trade embargoes upon our opponents and encourage free-trade across the Großgermanisches Reich.
strings.GER_scale_back_military_production_desc: Yet another of Speer's gripes with the economy is the influence held upon German industry by the Wehrmacht. Military needs are playing to far great a role in the economy. Germany's massive military costs a ridiculous amount on its own, and a tremendous amount of the German industrial base is dedicated to keeping it supplied. Therefore, Speer has wisely determined that the Reich's economic situation would improve if we were to scale back our military production - as it's unlikely that the Reich will be engaged in a major conflict anytime soon.
strings.GER_too_little_too_late_desc: In recent weeks the situation within the Großgermanisches Reich has worsened, counter to Speer's belief that they would have improved due to the implementation of reformist economic policies. Instead Herr Speer has begun to realize that things are going to get worse before they get better, and at this rate it'll be quite some time before the Reich is able to achieve economic reform. It's more than obvious that we've achieved too little too late...
strings.GER_heydrich_desc: With the Führer's proclamation of Deputy Reichsführer-SS Reinhard Heydrich as successor, public opinion is firmly united against this choice, with only the most die-hard Schutzstaffel lunatics publicly supporting Heydrich's bid. An extremely controversial choice, Herr Heydrich has little to non-existent support in Germany, with much of his support coming from Ordensstaat Burgund and the Reichsführer-SS Heinrich Himmler. As the Führer's health worsens, Herr Heydrich must move quickly to annihilate those who dare oppose and secure the Reich for himself and the 'Black Order' of the SS.
strings.GER_heydrich_chosen:
Wir kämpfen für Deutschland,
Wir kämpfen für Hitler,
Der Rote kommt nie mehr zur Ruh'
strings.GER_crush_the_protesters_desc: In the aftermath of the Führer's announcement the Fatherland has experienced a sharp increase in the amount of anti-government/pro-reformist acts of protests, along with the veracity of said protests. To secure the Fatherland we must permanently halt the spread of ideals counter to that of National-Socialism. As a result, we must show no mercy toward the protestors, as they themselves have exposed their anti-government leanings... They must and will be crushed!
strings.GER_smile_beside_hitler_desc: To show not only the Party but the nation that Herr Heydrich is worthy of the Führer's proclamation, we must show the population that we do indeed have the Führer's approval and are therefore legitimate. Therefore, we shall smile beside the Führer and present Herr Heydrich as a loyal National Socialist who truly represents the Führer's political will and testament and a man who can truly lead the Reich into glory once more.
strings.GER_implicate_the_militarists_desc: To successfully seize the apparatus of state, we must first do away with our opponents in the Wehrmacht who continue to cause us considerable headaches. Given our unbridled control over Reich Main Security Office (RSHA), we have the capability to easily falsify evidence and issue arrest warrants with little resistance. Therefore, we shall recover supposedly 'lost' documents which seem to implicate the Wehrmacht's hawks in a plot against the Reich...
strings.GER_shoot_the_liberals_desc: With the announcement of Reichsführer-SS Heydrich as the Führer's successor, the loathsome degenerates of the liberal movement have decided to intensify their protests over the past few months. All other attempts to halt the protests have been futile - therefore we must use more 'brutal' methods. It's time that the Reich's 'liberals' bite the non-proverbial bullet, these traitors are to be put down like the dogs they are!
strings.GER_intimidate_the_politicians_desc: Regardless of race, creed and ethnicity, politicians are all alike in one regard - they're all spineless lying cowards. It's clear to Reichsführer-SS Heydrich that if we are to convince the Reich's politicians to join us in our crusade against degeneracy and anti-NSDAP sentiment, we must use intimidation tactics. We shall return to the olden days of intimidation that was successful decades prior as we first established our hold over the German nation.
strings.GER_expel_the_ambassadors_desc: To truly reclaim the Reich from degeneracy we must exterminate all aspects of foreign influence from within its borders. In accordance with this message, we have no choice but to expel the ambassadors of oppossing nation-states who may eventually attempt to aid factions opposed to the SS as we continue to solidify our ever expanding grip over the Großgermanisches Reich.
strings.GER_dissolve_the_reichstag_desc: The Reichstag, the Diet of the Großgermanisches Reich is a continual thorn in the side of Reichsführer-SS Heydrich and the Schutzstaffel as a whole. Given how it's a representative body, it has the power to directly influence and challenge the government, something which it's members aren't afraid to do - as shown with the Diet's opposition to Herr Heydrich's appointment. Therefore, if we are to truly control the Reich we must dissolve the Reichstag as it's no longer necessary, often times disrupting the work of government.
strings.GER_mobilize_the_ss_desc: With the Führer's choice to appoint Reichsführer-SS Heydrich as his successor, it's clear he desires a truly National Socialist state under the management of the Black Order - though many happen to disagree. To ensure our legitimacy remains intact we must make the first move in this nation-wide game of chess - we have to make the first move. Therefore it's time to mobilize the Schutzstaffel and prepare the way for Heydrich's Führership!
strings.GER_replace_the_garrisons_desc: In the Reich's major metropolitan areas the Heer is entrusted with garrison duties, supposedly to keep the peace. Yet, in recent years with the majority of the Reich's cities engulfed in protest and crime, they've clearly failed in their mission of order. Thereby providing us with casus belli to replace these failures with the proper National Socialist men of the Schutzstaffel who, unlike the Wehrmacht, will succeed in restoring order.
strings.GER_supply_the_waffen_desc: With our newfound influence over matters of governance in the Reich, it's time we implement a policy of favoritism with regard to supply. In order to strengthen our position in the run-up to the Führer's eventual passing, it's time for us to allocate a greater amount of supply to Schutzstaffel Divisions - which will of course negatively impact our rivals in the Wehrmacht and establish where our loyalties lie.
strings.GER_redeploy_the_heer_desc: To succeed in our mission of successfully promulgating the supremacy of the Schutzstaffel to the Wehrmacht, the time has come to strategically redeploy the Heer to benefit the rise of the SS. By conducting this seemingly strange maneuver of men, we will further secure the position of the Schutzstaffel with regard to eventually becoming the Reich's main fighting force. Our opponents in the Heer can whine and whine all they like, though it won't change anything.
strings.GER_pressure_the_kriegsmarine_desc: The Kriegsmarine is notorious as being the least political of the three branches of the Wehrmacht, yet also tends to be the most pro-Speer branch. Due to both reasons, it's where the SS has the least influence. Given the importance of the Kriegsmarine to the Reich's operations in the event of war, we must attempt to convince the men of the Kriegsmarine to support Herr Heydrich's bid for the Führership - to ensure the Reich remains stable.
strings.GER_cripple_communications_desc: To further destroy the Wehrmacht's ability to counter the Schutzstaffel, it's time we truly separate them from the Reich at large - by crippling their communications. If we are to conduct this rather dubious act, it'll increase our capabilities to counter the Wehrmacht in the event of possible conflict - as we'll be able to far more effectively strike down our opponents as it will be us who are prepared for war!
strings.GER_detente_with_burgundy_desc: Over the past decade relations between the Großgermanisches Reich and Ordensstaat Burgund have been strenuous to say the least. Yet, with the appointment of Reichsführer-SS Heydrich as the Führer's successor upon death, it's clear to us that's it's only right that we make pursue friendlier relations with the Burgundians. Therefore we shall enact a policy of 'détente' with Ordensstaat Burgund, thus paving the way for a renewal of once friendly relations.
strings.GER_end_travel_restrictions_desc: To truly improve German-Burgundian relations, we must end all draconian restrictions placed upon the nation over the past several years. The most glaring restriction is probably the odd travel restrictions between the Reich and her western puppet - restricting who can rightfully enter Himmler's kingdom. Now that Herr Heydrich's influence in government is secure, we shall end said restrictions - thus allowing all Germans to travel freely between the Reich and Burgundy.
strings.GER_stop_the_sanctions_desc: Due to the formerly hostile leadership of the Großgermanisches Reich attempting to counter Burgundian ambitions, unfair trade sanctions were placed upon trade with Ordensstaat Burgund - which ultimately resulted in their economy weakening. However, this will not continue for long! To truly establish cordiality between the Reich and Burgundy we have little choice but to lift all sanctions upon the state - thus alleviating Burgundy's economic woes and resulting in a strengthening of ties between us and our party comrades abroad.
strings.GER_burgundian_reinforcements_desc: With the internal situation of the Großgermanisches Reich quickly deteriorating despite our attempts to the contrary. It seems as if our only hope to secure the Reich for Reichsführer-SS Heydrich lies with Herr Himmler's fiefdom. We must call upon our Burgundian allies for support. Given our recent relaxation in policy toward Ordensstaat Burgund, Herr Himmler will surely assist us in claiming the Reich for the Schutzstaffel once and for all!
strings.GER_WW3_gotterdamerung_desc:
The time has come at last. The inevitable war between superpowers that the world has been dreading has finally broken out!

Like the other Great Wars before, we must throw all of our effort into winning this war; nothing short of mobilizing all of our assets will grant us victory.

For Germany, we will fight! We've come too far to bow down to foreigners who would destroy all we have built.
strings.GER_WW3_to_the_frontlines_desc: Our current amount of men deployed in the frontlines is simply inadequate. For such a global, wide-reaching war, we need an army that has the numbers to fight multiple fronts in a multitude of theatres. If we hope to achieve victory, we need more men.
strings.GER_WW3_to_the_factories_desc: It's simple, really. Every German citizen must do their part for the war. If you're a man and not fighting, then you should be employed, working in our war industry. There is no reason women can't be called up to arms either; every person that is at our disposal should be working for our war effort. Every pair of hands counts!
strings.GER_WW3_totaler_krieg_desc: Few want to accept it, but we have no choice, and we can not delay. We need to retool our economy like we did before. Every good we make will be for the war effort in one way or another. Any non-vital consumer goods will be done away with; we can not afford to be producing luxuries in a time where every bullet, bomb, and rifle is vitally needed.
strings.GER_WW3_finishing_the_job_desc:
This war with America will be our last.

Our last showdown ended in basically a draw. America may have been humiliated to a small degree, but they were by no means humbled. They ended the Second Weltkrieg with an unparalleled industry, a still formidable navy, and a massive army that never really saw any large scale fighting.

This war will be different. We are going to finish what we should have started two decades ago. The American giant will be humbled and beaten by Germany, once and for all!
strings.GER_WW3_secure_the_isles_desc: Our first stepping stone on our way to America is the British Isles. While we start a program to massively increase our number of marines, we will likewise give the British the chance to submit to our demands. All countries across the English channel will be given a simple ultimatum; they will submit to us and join us against America, or they will be crushed once again by the might of the Wehrmacht!
strings.GER_WW3_amerika_bomber_desc:
During the Second World War, a concept, nicknamed the 'Amerika Bomber' was drawn up. The plans were to design a long range strategic bomber that had enough range and survivability to fly across the Atlantic, drop a respectable payload on the American east coast, then make a return flight back to Europe.

The project was soon dropped; our fathers did not have the resources of technology to complete such an ambitious project. Today, their dreams can become reality!

We have the technology and we have the resources. We only need to combine the two and add in some German ingenuity.
strings.GER_WW3_operation_alaric_desc:
The inevitable war with our old ally has finally broken out. Italy, for a decade, has stood defiant against all that the Reich stands for. The ingrates have been plotting our demise and working against us with political alliances, those so called 'Great Games', and so on. Well, enough is enough.

The score shall soon be settled, once and for all. Nothing so elaborate like a web of political alliances will decide our futures, however. No, only war will end this rivalry, one way or another.
strings.GER_WW3_over_the_alps_desc:
There will be no grandois, elaborate plan for encircling the Italian Empire and crushing it. We are not going on an expedition throughout Africa and the Middle East to crush their colonial holding before we go for their throat. Sometimes, the best plan is the most simple one; we are going to go straight for the Italian's juglar and march straight to Rome.

The largest barrier to our efforts will be crossing the imposing Alps. If we are going to realistically move our armies and supplies through them, we will need to secure the passes that the Swiss control. As our men train and equip themselves for the inevitable mountain fighting, we shall send an ultimatum to Switerlands; let us through your country and use your mountain passes, or we will come and secure them ourselves.
strings.GER_WW3_endsieg_desc:
Foreign boots are marching in our lands. The war, despite our best efforts, has turned against us, and there is little hope that we can turn back this tide.

Our options lessen by the hour; we are left with no choice but to launch our nuclear arsenal against our enemies. This solution is the only solution where Germany is still able to win. Ultimate Victory will be ours, and although the price will be costly, no cost is too great for Endsieg.
