strings.GER_VEN.1.desc:
TOP SECRET
EYES ONLY
TO ALL MEMBERS OF THE {getintelagencycaps}

VENEZUELA - LATIN AMERICA

Our worst fears surrounding Venezuela have come true surrounding the Fuerzas Armadas de Liberácion Nationale (FALN). FALN-FLN troops in Venezuela seized control of Ciudad Bolívar and several other cities in the East, after the front declared a general uprising against the government. Sympathetic civilians have assisted the rebels in their offensive, allowing them to seize almost the entire east in a matter of hours. Despite the FALN intending a swift, large-scale revolution across the country, units in the west appear to have been pushed back to the Andes, allowing the central government to survive and reconsolidate. However, the uprising has escalated into a full-scale civil war.

The group first emerged in 1961 following a split with the former liberal government of Wolgang Larrazábal and the Communist Party of Venezuela, but has become far stronger since the new, amenable government came into power. With the end of Venezuelan democracy, they have gained considerable support, both from general opponents as well as some radicalised liberals. With leftist success across much of Latin America already in play, excitement among Bolsheviks allowed the FALN to gain significant momentum. This civil war has already seen early fighting, but this will not stop at the frontlines; there is significant partisan warfare already, and an extended civil war will likely break down surviving civilian infrastructure.

It would be dangerous to allow this revolution to be completed. Not only would this allow for the extension of Judeo-Bolshevism further in the Americas, it would also greatly hamper the strength of our sphere across Latin America and the Caribbean, and lead to the loss of a major trade partner. Defeating this movement would help us to build credibility in the region, and would help preserve our access to a major international oil reserve. Currently, the west of the country has resisted this rebellion, reducing it from a full revolution, but the communists will only gain more power as the revolution goes on. If we hope to conduct an effective extermination campaign of the Venezuelan rebels, we should aim to do so quickly.

MAY GERMANY BE IN SAFE HANDS
strings.GER_VEN.1.a: Best to get to it, then.
strings.GER_VEN.4.desc:
If nothing else, Lake Maracaibo was certainly one of the prettier sights Kelker could find in this sorry venture. The view from the office space in downtown Maracaibo could have been better, but it offered one where the afternoon sun still shone off the water like a great, glistening sapphire. Just as attractive, for different reasons, was the series of titanic Oil rigs far along the horizon.

Otherwise, logistical support for Venezuela was about as harrowing as a trip to the bathroom for the Deutsches Expeditionkorps. With the map laid out before him and a wax pencil in hand, Kelker's afternoon was one of 'dotting'. Dotting routes for fuel convoys to Guárico, dotting ammunition shipments to the frontline in Apure, dotting spare rotor part allocations for helicopters in Barquisimeto. At times, He had to stifle urges to 'dot' his own eyeballs, harshly.

“-and reports of theft, again!” Colonel Carmona was well into his rant. “Men taking bribes, supply leaks on the motorway south, this is chaos!” Carmona could have been a lot worse, decent as he perhaps was to commandeer the upper floors of this office building for the ExKor. Kelker kept a tight lip, listening and nodding and not deigning to take any notes.

Kelker thought of a line by Junger, the chestnut about how men in the officer's club can 'talk' about goings-on at the frontlines. He recognized the scene, even if the backdrop was different. Gaps in supply, holes in infrastructure, with men at the front were struggling to simply not die. A bitter lesson, learned late, dotted in the paper trail on the road to Moskowien during the West Russian War.
strings.GER_VEN.4.a: Kelker drew a line: “No more trucks on that route, you're just feeding men to guerrilleros.”
strings.GER_VEN.5.desc:
Up and down, up and down. The churning Oil derricks in the distance was at once benign and hypnotic, such was life working the refineries on the Orinoco Belt. That's how Solano saw it. As a Foreman, it was on him to keep the machine of the Venezuelan Oil industry, vital to the nation's economy, working at capacity. It was gritty work more of than not, but it was an everyman's kind of work. That was what made their presence in Orinoco so odd. The plant Solano worked at did so under the new safety and efficiency protocols, the ones created by the German technical mission since their arrival years ago. No one working at the refinery had an issue with the new rules anymore than Solano did, it was rather the... other additions to their work life.

Sitting in the cafeteria with the workers from his site, Solano spied the signs above the counter, written in both Spanish and in German, denoting both the caraotas and arepas they had on tap alongside boiled potatoes and weißwurst. The dual signage continued well outside the cafeteria, all the way to the front gate practically.

In that cafeteria were Solano's colleagues from the technical team, almost all German, who ate opposite to them. The technicians and the workers, the latter of whom were almost all Venezuelan, might have been a mirror image of one another, were it not for the obvious differences.

However, the Germans were far from the most threatening presence in Orinoco. Plumes of black smoke billowed over the outline of the Oil derricks, somewhere beyond the fence where a truck had been hit by the guerrilleros just the other night. It had even Solano paranoid, checking and double checking security tapes for any sign of rebel sabotage. His supervisor, a stout German named Steinman, even he was weirdly helpful and accommodating in that regard; No anger, no dogma.

He just watched and took notes.
strings.GER_VEN.5.a: If there was any animosity, none was spoken aloud.
strings.GER_VEN.7.desc:
Táchira was a different beast, one that Ulrich didn't expect to find so familiar. The Obersoldat remembered the stories of the march through Belarus, where his father had fought, and the dire tales he regaled his son with. Dark forests, long shadows, the eerie stink of wet leaves and rusting metal traps erected by Soviet partisans. One might say the apple didn't fall far from the tree, but one would have to ask where the tree was planted for him to wind up here, of all places.

The hinterlands of the Andes in western Venezuela wasn't like anything the ExKorps could have expected. One might have pictured South America as one giant jungle rimmed by a snaking mountain range, yet Táchira was closer to the mountainous forests of Europe than anything. Cold at night, breath misting up in front of you. It might as well have been the bloody Black Forest as opposed to the mouth of the snake the men of Wehrmacht found itself in.

Sergeant Budde motioned for the patrol to stop, pointing to ground. Tripwires, half-buried under the moss, guerrillero work. The Venezuelan soldiers, with whom the ExKorps detachment was to accompany on patrol, were quick to go to work, carefully disarming the trap with the point of a knife. No one said a word, something of a trend between the two of them. 'Ideas of nationhood were hardly welcome to any man in a place like this' His father's words.

As the patrol continued on, the crack of a gunshot was heard, somewhere well behind them, likely from one of their number, either grouping. One might ask why or what for or for who, but after Ukraine, Budde learned it was better not to think about it.
strings.GER_VEN.7.a: It always meant the same thing anyway, or so Budde told himself.
strings.GER_VEN.8.desc:
The cafeteria at the Oil Refinery in Puerto la Cruz along the Orinoco was still open the day peace was declared, and while all were surely relieved on some level, it was received with the same uncanny banality as just about everything else at the plant. Solano and the Venezuelan workers toiled in the field, the German technicians walked the floors with clipboards while they checked readouts, inspected pressure gauges and logged maintenance cycles. What seemed strange before was only strange now in that it wasn't so strange anymore.

Again, Solano sat with his team at their table and ate. Again, Steinman sat with the technicians at their table and ate. Again, the cooks were serving arepas and caraotas alongside boiled sausage and potatoes, with signs denoting either written in both Spanish and German. By now, the Venezuelan crew had grown accustomed to the rhythm of things. Don't talk too much, do your job, keep your hard hat tipped low. No fuss, no muss.

In the distance past the cafeteria window, Solano could hear the tell-tale signs of his country rebuilding itself, the groaning of construction machinery along the highway dismantling the military barricades mingling with the churning of the oil derricks. Up and down, up and down. But as before, everything in the refinery was much the same, an engineering marvel, backed by the Venezuelan working class and German industrial science.

If anything, it looked as if the extraction and refining operation in the Orinoco was only just the beginning, with plenty of room to advance and grow.
strings.GER_VEN.8.a: Everyone had their place in the sun.
strings.GER_VEN.9.desc:
Gabriel Turmero was cleaner cut than his service record should have implied. Between the head-to-toe kevlar coverall and the well-maintained, working sniper rifle, he might have been mistaken for riot response or private security. The receding brown hair and close-cropped side burns added to the image of a professional soldier, something that the mercenary prided himself on, as not all hired guns necessarily had to look like one.

Turmero couldn't say for sure, but he half-suspected that was part of the reason the catires had hired him. The Germans weren't always so picky about freelancer auxiliaries, especially now what with the Reds now in charge in Caracas, but Nazis were just another flavor of aristo and might prefer people more... pleasant to their eyes.

Rushing to escape the Reds, the last of the equipment had been loaded on the trucks. Yet despite the haste, the Germans remained precise, folding their maps, packing their rifles, sealing their crates. The trucks kicked up a cloud of dust, pushing past the checkpoint outside Barquisimeto like an olive-green caterpillar. Turmero and the Venezuelan mercenaries, rifles slung over their shoulders, said little, sharing a cigar while watching the Germans with muted curiosity as they pulled onto the highway and disappeared behind a curve of tall grass and eucalyptus trees.

There wasn't any hostility between them, weirdly, just the knowledge that the situation had changed. With the fall of the old regime, Turmero and the former men of the armed forces were just as out of a job as the former German advisors were.
strings.GER_VEN.9.a: The checkpoint would still be there the next day, as would Turmero, now paid by a Red manager.
strings.GER_VEN.10.t: Black Gold and the Deal of the Century
strings.GER_VEN.10.desc:
The doors to the conference hall at Miraflores Palace swung open at exactly 14:03, as if obeying an invisible chronometer. Hermann Josef Abs entered first, wielding an “H. Upmann” cigar - a trophy from a batch found in the wine cellar of the Hôtel Ritz Paris in the summer of 1940.

His entourage followed like a silent shadow: stone-faced men in grey suits of worsted wool, woven in the mills of the Ruhr. They clutched pigskin briefcases made in Offenbach. The clasps clicked shut with a dry, sharp sound, reminiscent of a hammer being cocked.

Abs took his seat opposite the Venezuelans, not bothering with polite smiles. “Let us get straight to business, caballeros,” he said. His Spanish was flawless, devoid of caricature, dry and functional. “The Siemens concern is ready to deliver the G-400 series pumping complexes, developed specifically for viscous crude, by March. Pipes of Krupp steel, rolled in Essen, will withstand pressures that would tear American counterparts to shreds. Our double-hulled tankers are already anchored offshore...”

Pedro Tinoco nervously twirled a Parker 51 fountain pen with a gold nib in his hands - a graduation gift from his father in 1948. He looked at the German and saw not a man, but a functioning machine.

“...Washington and Madrid can offer you nothing, but we...” Abs continued, tapping ash into a massive crystal ashtray. “... Eight percent annual GDP growth. Guaranteed markets within the EEC. A seat in the engine of the global economy, not in the rear car.”

Tinoco felt cold sweat forming beneath his shirt collar. To sign this contract was to shake hands with the devil. But the devil paid in gold, and the world stood on the precipice of the Oil Crisis. He unscrewed the cap of his Parker.
strings.GER_VEN.10.a: The Reichsmark has no conscience, but it carries weight.
strings.GER_VEN.10.tt:
With our recent victories in the Americas and the fading presence of {ibr_getflag} Iberia in the region, their {ven_getflag} Venezuelan partners have deemed it necessary to seek {ger_getflag} our sponsorship.
------------------------------------
strings.GER_VEN.11.desc:
Arturo Uslar Pietri stared at the folder lying on the mahogany desk, a piece of furniture confiscated from the estate of Pérez Jiménez back in the last decade. The signature on the document had already dried. The ink had soaked into the paper permanently, like blood into sand.

The German offer was flawless. The economic forecasts, typed on crisp paper, promised explosive growth. The green line on the charts shot into the stratosphere, promising to realize Pietri's greatest dream - to “sow the oil,” turning black sludge into schools, hospitals, and roads. The Reich was winning in the Americas, and its shadow was covering the continent, offering protection and prosperity.

Diego Cisneros, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, stood by the window, pretending to study the treetops in the courtyard. He avoided meeting the President's eyes. The oligarchs, the true architects of power, the ones who had put Uslar Pietri in this chair, had already made their choice. Cisneros was a friend, perhaps the only person in that clique of oligarchs with whom one could speak sincerely, but even he, one of its key members, dared not contradict the “Masters of the Valley.”

German capital flowed faster than American capital; it was more efficient and, most importantly, asked no unnecessary questions. Uslar felt nauseous. Nazism, that refined barbarism, evoked physical disgust in him, an intellectual and a writer. Cisneros felt the same.

And yet, the deal was done. They had sold their souls to buy a future for the country. One could only hope that history would be a far more lenient judge than their own conscience.
strings.GER_VEN.12.t: Black Gold and a Distant Howl
strings.GER_VEN.12.desc:
The soundproof panels made of compressed cork were failing. The dull thuds of tear gas grenades and the crackle of automatic fire from the street leaked inside, creating a grim accompaniment to the Foreign Minister's speech.

Edito Ramírez was spewing words, choking on his own panic. Drops of sweat fell from his nose onto the polished surface of the table, leaving spots next to the ashtray. He offered everything: oil concessions for ninety-nine years, full control over the ports of La Guaira, extraterritoriality for German garrisons.

Moncada Vidal sat beside him, motionless as a statue. He stared at the German ambassador's cufflink - a gold disc with an engraving, gleaming dully under the light of fluorescent lamps that flickered treacherously due to power surges. The “Dance of the Dogs” was devouring Caracas. The streets were drowning in blood, and the Bolivarian regime was burning out like a discarded cigarette butt.

One thought revolved in Moncada's mind: they had bet on the wrong horse. Iberia turned out to be a decrepit nag that stumbled at the start. If ten years ago they had pledged allegiance to the Reich... perhaps now he would be drinking schnapps instead of listening to the mob outside demanding his head. He didn't give a damn about history. History is a fairy tale for survivors.

The German diplomats sat with faces hewn from granite. No emotion, no sympathy. The head of the delegation nodded slowly, cutting off Ramírez's stream of words. They saw before them a cornered, wounded beast that could be squeezed for every last drop of blood before being put down or chained up.
strings.GER_VEN.12.a: “We accept,” the German lead diplomat said.
strings.GER_VEN.13.desc:
The air conditioner was running at full power, yet Hermann Josef Abs seemed to have brought the chill of northern Europe with him. In his hand smoldered a cigar - Brazilian, “Dona Flor” brand, from a special batch.

Abs spoke calmly. His heavy German accent grated against the Spanish vowels, but the meaning was clear: growth. Not abstract liberty, but tons of steel, cubic meters of concrete, and kilowatts of energy. Leoch, the head translator, scribbled furiously in a notebook, trying to keep up with the technical terms.

Pérez Jiménez listened without interrupting. Inside him, a cold contempt for the rest of the world was festering. The Americans had betrayed him, bogged down in their own softness and flabby democracy. The Iberians were weak, like an old widow living on memories. Germany, however... Germany understood the language of strength.

The dictator's gaze slid over the map of the Americas hanging on the wall. The German eagle was spreading its wings over the continent, and only an idiot could fail to see which way the wind of history was blowing. Pérez Jiménez saw in Abs not just a banker, but a reflection of his own ambitions. There was no need for hypocrisy here.

Leónidas Sánchez Carrero, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, nervously adjusted his horn-rimmed glasses, observing the scale of the concessions, and the growth that would come with them. But the General had already made his decision.
strings.GER_VEN.13.a: The Adler and the Troupial look in the same direction.
strings.GER_VEN.14.desc:
Hans-Jürgen Meissner, senior analyst for the South American desk, carefully brushed a flake of puff pastry off the folder stamped “Vertraulich”. The apple strudel from the “Buchwald” bakery, bought during his lunch break, was particularly good today - with just the right amount of cinnamon and warm vanilla sauce, which was now threatening to drip onto the report.

The document dryly outlined the facts regarding the regime change in Caracas. Meissner turned the page, licking the sweet sauce off the silver spoon. The situation was most curious. Venezuela, that oil barrel sitting on a powder keg, had changed owners once again.

The analyst chuckled. The Iberians, of course, consider this their victory. In Madrid and Lisbon, they are surely popping champagne corks right now, believing they have kept their wayward colony on a leash. Fools. The new masters of Miraflores Palace are clearly desperate for cash and technology, and the Iberian Union possesses neither in sufficient quantities.

“Sphere of influence,” Hans-Jürgen muttered, spearing a piece of apple with his fork. “Is a flexible concept.”

For the Reich, this was a chance. The Americans had been kicked out, their “backyard” is burning, and the smoke from that fire smells of opportunity. Venezuela is not German yet, far from it, but the door that Washington tried to slam shut, and Iberia tried to brace with its shoulder, is now slightly ajar. And the toe of a German boot is already wedged in the crack

Meissner closed the folder, wiped his lips with a napkin, and stamped it “FOR REVIEW.” The strudel was finished, and with it, his interest in the suffering of a distant tropical country.
strings.GER_VEN.14.a: The door is ajar, and the German enters without knocking.
strings.GER_VEN.14.tt:
The {ger_getflag} Reich will only be able to claim {ven_getflag} Caracas if
 {ibr_getflag} Madrid loses its foothold in the {col_getflag} Northern Andes and {ger_getflag} German influence is sufficient to fill the void in the region.
------------------------------------
strings.GER_Operation_Fuhrer_Breadbasket_desc:
With the establishment of the Ukrainian Hetmanate in the place of our former Reichskommissariat of Ukraine, which fed almost half of our population in the south, as well as the army, all these food supplies were stopped. Fertile ukrainian black soils, combined with the hard work of the local untermensch, allowed us to keep our entire living space in the east in humility and peace. With the restoration of our control by either negotiation or military force throughout Central Europe, we moved to reclaim the german bastion of control over all of Eastern Europe.

Having defeated all the untermanche partisans in Ostland without any problems in a short time, it was time to take revenge on the rebellious ukrainians and teach them a lesson that it is impossible to challenge the mighty Aryan Eagle, which is returning its undisputed property. However, this campaign in the ukrainian swamps of Polissia will be a logistical pain, and the forests of Volhynia may stop our advance for a while, making prolonged combat impossible. Also, to our surprise, the hetmanists government and the self-proclaimed Hetman - leader of the Ukranian Hetmanate are ready to make all possible compromises from the first day of our invasion. They will give up their economic independence, partly their territorial sovereignty and partly their political independence in order to achieve peace.

But is our subjugation of a country that will not surrender and is ready to fight to the last village worth it, expensive in terms of human military resources? They are not afraid of the airstrikes of our fighters and assault aircraft, which strike their military units and settlements every day, they are not afraid of our tank strikes, which cannot pass through the local swamps and forests, even our status as a nuclear power does not confuse them. After all, they are now not against playing the role of the “Bread Basket” of the Reich, which was performed by the Reichskommissariat, and their defeats at the front will be able to further persuade them to sign a peace agreement beneficial to us...
strings.GER_meeting_with_generals_HUN: Hold a Meeting of General Staff
strings.GER_Der_Letzte_Krieg_desc:
After finally securing our mandate over a reforged Europe, we thought that our Thousand Year Reich was safe. It turns out we were wrong. After a tumultuous 60s, it seems the 70s have only brought us one thing: war. The Slavs are coming back for their lands, and they are coming back with a vengeance.

We must use every resource at our disposal to turn back this Russian tide and send them crawling back towards the Urals where they belong. Our factories will be turned once more into machines for war. Our people will be forged into weapons to beat down the Slavic horde and save our civilization from destruction. This is the conflict of the century, and we shall rise from it victorious!
strings.GER_Die_Grenzwacht_Hielt_Im_Osten_desc:
We have underestimated our foe. The barbarians came hammering at our gates, and for a moment it appeared that our gates were crumbling as the hordes poured into our colony. But, by a miracle of German will and might, the border guards have held enough to stall the offensive. But now is not the time for apathy; now is the time for action.

We must support our men on the front lines if we are to turn the tide of this war. The East is ours to hold, and we must shed our blood, sweat, and tears to see that it remains so. The Heer is the greatest military this Earth has ever seen; let's show these Slavs what it means to be Aryan.
strings.GER_Invigorate_The_Reich_desc:
With the tide not in our favor, support on the homefront is more important than ever. The German will is an essential ingredient to victory, and we must remind the people of our glorious civilization, and the cost of losing it to the Slavic menace.

We will hold rallies across the country, with party members giving fiery orations to rile up the masses, reminding them of our former victories. We will initiate propaganda campaigns, commission films, and show the people the horrors of these monsters that threaten to tear down everything we have built over the last few decades. Everything is at stake in this war; we must remind the people of their destiny.
strings.GER_Every_Last_Contract_desc:
There has been another issue that our war machine has encountered: we simply do not have enough supplies to reach the front. Despite our best efforts to increase productivity with our factories, our logistics are spread too thin and are too incohesive to provide sufficient supplies for our army. We must find a remedy for this issue immediately, and we do have a few tricks up our sleeves still to alleviate this problem.

Since our factories owe us a favor for their newly created unpaid workforce, we can take up all contracts that our industrious companies can issue, and direct them entirely to our military. There is no greater threat right now than the Russian Bear kicking down our door, and the threat of losing everything we have strived for is at stake. By allowing a few wheels to be greased, every need, from the spoons to feed our soldiers to the most technically complicated weapons systems, our military will be at full strength in no time.
strings.GER_Mobilize_The_Veterans_desc:
As the manpower we hold decreases and the Slavic horde grows larger, we need to fill up the gaps. Our best bet is with our old veterans from this century’s previous wars, especially those who have experience from the First West Russian War. Not all veterans are equal, however, and so we will have to sort them first by their experience, knowledge of modern day tactics, and overall physical health.

Depending on their capabilities, they shall either be given the latest arms the Reich has to offer, or leftover equipment from our previous conflicts.  They shall do well in serving the Fatherland once more, whether they use their training to return as frontline troops or impart their training as Military Instructors.
strings.GER_Die_Ostlegion_desc:
With the war dragging on and our men grinded down to their weakest points, we once more need soldiers to tend to the east. As we did during Barbarossa and the First West Russian War, we will recruit Russians and any other collaborators willing to help us push the bear back. We shall organize these recruits according to their loyalty to the Reich, their loyalty to the cause of National Socialism, their willingness to fight, and of course their overall health. As we did with sorting our veterans, our collaborators will either be given modern equipment or leftover equipment.

The Slavic Hordes shall have to grind through their own first with massive conscripts serving to patch up our lines and keep the horde from pushing onwards. The hordes shall then have to face the reality that not all wish to return back into barbarism as they face off against divisions of loyal Slavs we deem to be honorary Aryans. We can only hope then that the Slavic Hordes break before our loyal Ostlegion does.
strings.GER_Pressure_The_Corporations_desc:
It would seem our so-called “loyal” corporations have been failing the needs of our army greatly, and it appears to be stemming from their lack of cooperation with the state. Accordingly, we can begin using what language they know, and, ultimately, have no choice but to respect: fear.

We can begin by forcing key magnates of these corporations into surrendering their holdings to the state, and liquidating whatever resources we need from these companies. Threats of foreclosure will ensure that they will never be able to give “No” as an answer to our demands. Since we have also allowed the slave economy to thrive once more, we may also manipulate the flow of free workers into these companies, and starve them out until they obey every last command we issue. Whatever we do, we can and must deal with this issue immediately.
strings.GER_Die_Wahrheit_ist_der_Feind_desc:
Morale is what oils the cogs of the German war machine; manpower and guns mean nothing if our own soldiers lack spirit and discipline. The issue of morale extends to the general masses. The loyalty of the civilian populace is a necessity if we are to win this war against the Slavic menace. While our war against the Russian invaders has been tenuous, the people need not know.

We will manipulate the flow of information to only show the victories we have secured. We will prevent any news of defeats from reaching the homefront. Anyone who says otherwise will be arrested on charges of treason. What the people don't know can't hurt them.
strings.GER_Ein_Totaler_Krieg_desc:
As the war has not gone in our favor, we have been met with a horrible realization. We grow closer day by day to losing our beloved German Reich. Our Fatherland. This war has turned into one of survival, and to survive we must fight with every facet we have to ensure the final total victory of the German people. In one last grasp for victory we will launch a theater wide offensive to break the Bear's legions and its spirit.

The German people must fight all hours of the day, as the Führer orders, and give everything for victory. We shall use our propaganda machine to make our people desire total war. If necessary, we shall spin the necessary measures we have taken in the East as war crimes conducted by the Slavic hordes. This shall remind the German people of their duty to wage a war more total and radical than anything that the world has ever imagined. It is now victory or death.
strings.GER_Unleash_The_Wolves_desc:
A war of this magnitude requires a vast depth of assets for us to call on when needed. One asset we can always rely on is that of our partisan movement: die Wolfe. Making themselves known within the Russian-occupied Moskowien, these brave sons and daughters of Germania have shown themselves to be worthy adversaries of the average Russian soldier. To keep them supplied for further operations against Russian forces, we must allow these forces to be well-equipped to take on even the strongest of units of the Russian military.

We can dispatch a few advisors and weapons via an airdrop, and from there we can help to establish a partisan network within Moskowien itself. If all goes according to plan, in no time we should be able to further disrupt our enemies from making any further gains or consolidating what they've already gained. There will be Hell to pay for the Russians when it comes to taking what is rightfully ours.
strings.GER_More_Hands_In_The_Factories_desc:
With the start of the Second West Russian War, we've encountered a glaring weakness in our economy. The demands required for this conflict have shown that, even with all of our industrial might and resources, we simply have fewer workers to keep our machines functioning.  Since the war has demanded our most loyal citizens to the front, we must revert to what methods led us to ultimate victory in the first war: slavery.

We will make the legal precessions and accommodations necessary for our most diligent companies to employ the “undesirables” once more to increase our factories' collective output. There will be liquidations of some villages in the Ostfront, of course, but it would be foolish to let the hands of potential workers fall into that of our Asiatic nemesis. Once the policy is employed throughout the Reich, we can expect as many as 100,000 slaves within the month, freshly brought in from our Eastern frontier.
strings.GER_End_The_Tiresome_Partisan_desc:
Like we have with the Werewolves, the Russians have propped up partisan groups across our Eastern domain that have grown into more of a pain in our side day by day. We shall go into every village and every city to find these partisans and kill them at the source. It shall be the job of every one of our collaborators to snuff out these rats before they eat into our fighting strength.

First, we shall issue notices that the men of the East must find a partisan or risk being labeled as one. We shall reinforce these notices by having special brigades in charge going door to door and house to house to round up as many as they can. Once these rats are found, we shall dispose of them as we usually do: display their mangled corpses on every newspaper and on every lamp post to serve as examples to all who would resist the Reich. Additionally, we shall issue quotas for every one of these special brigades to fulfill, ensuring not a single shred of these partisans remain in the east.
strings.GER_Declaw_The_Bear_desc:
We have retaken a portion of our domain, just as planned. Germania is once more secure from foreign invasion, and now we must hold the line against further incursions by Russian troops. A line of defense shall be created, one which the bear will break its claws against as it tries to fight against our march of civilization. Once before, the Russians thought they could march into Moscow and take what we earned through the blood of the Wehrmacht. We threw them back, and we shall do so again.

There must be no retreat. All officers along the line shall be given the order: no step back. The defenses we construct will be the shield protecting our civilization, and we will force the Russians to the conference table, or we shall march across our line and cut off the bear's head ourselves.
strings.GER_Uber_Alles_desc: The resurgent Bear to the East has been crushed. Its armies and spirit lay shattered by the tanks and fighter jets that beat back their savage hordes. Our supremacy over Europe is now unquestionable alongside the renewed belief in the strength of National Socialism. With this momentous victory, we have made up for our failure in the First West Russian War, we have proven through fire and steel that the Aryan race is far superior to that of the base Slavic Untermenschen. For the first time in decades, the German people are in a celebratory mood. Crowds have lined the streets of Berlin to welcome the returning heroes. Our Reich is secure now and forevermore.
strings.GER_Verteidige_das_Vaterland_desc: The fate of our Reich and the integrity of our realm hangs in the balance. We proved our might when we crushed the Soviet Union in the 40s, but our unquestionable strength collapsed in the 50s when our forces barely managed to stem the tide of the Red Army remnants. Yet we managed to maintain our empire and our grip over Europe. But now, as the Russians pour forth from the East once more, the very existence of our Reich will be determined by this one, final war, a war we cannot afford to lose.
strings.GER_The_Means_of_War_desc: The mega corporations of the Reich have long had a stranglehold over our politics with their influence permeating every facet of German life. But now, as the very lands of our Vaterland lay open to invasion, none of them shall obstruct our military measures through political means. Those that resist will be dealt with harshly. While this may stunt our economy after the war ends, we must put the corporations on a tight leash; they must use all the resources at their disposal for our final victory.
strings.GER_The_Final_Line_desc: The Slavic horde has breached our perimeter. The Wehrmacht is in retreat. Our units have been broken in every counteroffensive we have mounted. They are pushing us back, kilometer by kilometer, straight towards our borders. We cannot allow this to continue. We must hunker down and salvage what remains of our units to mount a final defense of the Fatherland, no matter the cost. The humble soldier, the hero of Germania, is our final defense against the savagery and brutality of the bear.
strings.GER_Into_the_Ostfront_desc: Time and again the Wehrmacht has been defeated on the field of battle by the Slavic horde. The barbarians are nearly at our gates; we must defend our civilization. We shall conduct one last great counteroffensive and drive back the Slavic menace using all of the resources the Wehrmacht and Luftwaffe can muster. Now is the great trial of the Thousand Year Reich. Our frontier shall be brought back under our command no matter the cost. Let the final fate of the Reich be decided in the plains of Russia.
strings.GER_Wolves_of_the_Fatherland_desc: The Russian bear has clawed its way deep into our hard-won land. They think that the people of this land will welcome them with open arms, and that this land remains truly theirs. They are foolish to think so. We shall call on all Germans–soldiers or colonists–to take up arms behind their lines. Whether it be to cut communications, harass their supply lines, or assassinate their occupation forces, our wolves shall hunt them in every corner of Moskowien.
strings.GER_heusinger_party_long: Nationalsozialistische Deutsche Arbeiterpartei- Oberkommando der Wehrmacht
strings.GER_economic_apocalypse_desc: Germany's complete and utter defeat in the Second West Russian War has removed the heart of Reich from our control. Decades of infrastructural buildup, economic investment and resource extraction have disappeared virtually overnight, destroying crucial industries dependent on imports from the East and plunging our economy into a depression it may never recover from.
strings.GER_the_god_of_war_desc: Our fearsome Wehrmacht, an army whose sheer power and might bent the entire World to its knees and vanquished powers several times its size and strength, now lies dead at our feet. Impaled on the swords of “lesser” beings and left to rot away into nothing. Germany was once the God of War. A hegemon rivaling the empires of Rome and Macedon. Now we are the gods of nothing.
strings.GER_the_werewolf_threat_desc: Our young Democracy harbors a tumor, slowly growing and spreading across the Republic with every passing day. The Werewolves are not just a threat to Germany, but a threat to Europe as a whole. If we cannot cleanse them from our system, then it is only a matter of time before our protections and freedoms wither away into reactionary terror.
strings.GER_our_reich_of_ash_desc:
Our glorious Reich has been crushed by the onslaught of the Russian Bear, a defeat we once thought to be impossible. But it was not merely the Slavic Horde that shattered our mighty empire; we have been betrayed by enemies within the Reich itself!

These traitors cannot be allowed to triumph over the Aryan Spirit. Enemies clamor at the gates of the German Vaterland, but just as a phoenix must die so it may be reborn, so too will the Reich rise from the ashes to heights never before seen.
strings.GER_the_second_german_civil_war_desc: Hundreds of thousands of soldiers of the Wehrmacht have deserted their posts to unknown locations. Communism, Democracy and National Socialism have been pitted against each other in a war to decide the fate of Germany. Germany will either rise from the ashes of this terrible conflict or fall forevermore into ruin, and whatever the outcome, all of Europe will feel its reverberations.
strings.GER_a_nation_in_flames_desc: With the unforeseen defeat of the Reich at the hands of the Slavic Hordes, whispers of dissent and uprising have risen to an unstoppable crescendo. Ideologies long thought to have been thoroughly stamped out have sprung out of the woodworks like an endless tide of vermin. The Reich is tearing at its seams, fracturing disastrously as it once did nearly a decade ago. Germany is once more aflame with the Fires of War as brothers, fathers and sons of the Vaterland perish in the inescapable flame.
strings.GER_OKW_hissy_fit: Get me the head of the OKW! Now!
strings.GER_kylo_ren: We will gain more divisons to fend off the Russian menace.
strings.GER_funny_moment: Moskowien has fallen... We must resort to more extreme measures against the Slavic horde.
strings.GER_its_so_joever: One final gamble to save the Reich...
strings.GER_russia_is_now_fucked: The Untermensch has been crushed. The Reich shall hold for another millenium!
strings.GER_SWRW_Victory: The German Reich has driven back the Slavic Menace and won the Second West Russian War.
strings.GER_Reconstruction_of_Germany_desc:
Our flag may fly proudly over every city in Germany, but the ruins and scars remain. It's time to rebuild; house by house, building by building, road by road. It will take a long time, but it is necessary if we are to see our people prosper under our vision of Germany.

The cost will be high, and it may take years. Yet, Germany has always come out stronger. We recovered from the Napoleonic wars. We recovered from the Treaty of Versailles. We shall recover from this war.
strings.GER_Waldheim_DEF: das Großgermanische Reich der Deutschen Nation
strings.GER_difficulty_category_desc:
The train from Magadan to Brest Fortress is about to begin boarding, comrades. Oh, and welcome to Russia. It's time to reclaim our motherland.

Holy shit why are the Krauts so OP with all these Mars troops should've lowered the difficulty earlier--Anonymous Player
strings.GER_krakow_uprising_tt:
Since the triumph of 1945, Polen has become an increasingly integral part of the Reich. As the Polish savages are pushed further east by Aryan settlers, it was believed that the Polish state would never rise again.

How wrong we were.

When it seemed that the Poles had atlast been pacified, the remnants of the Polish resistance have risen up once again in a final hail mary for the liberation of Poland. While our most fanatical are demanding we throw the full weight of the Wehrmacht upon the rebels, many in our government fear that the Russian Federation will directly intervene, dooming Eastern Europe to another horrendous war.

Although the reconquest of Poland back into the Reich will be more complicated than in 1939, the Poles will crumble before the might of the German army once again and begin the reclamation of Europe in the name of the Aryan peoples.
strings.GER_mountain_war_desc_tt:
When Turkey joined the Axis, their involvement proved crucial in overwhelming the Soviet armies in the Caucasian mountains. After realising their Neo-Ottoman ambitions in the Middle East, the nation was for a time apart of the old Italian lead 'Triumvirate' before entering neutrality following the collapse of the alliance.

The Turks had assisted us in out struggle against the Allied Powers during the Second World War, therefore, it is only natural that we aid them against the Russian backed Armenia and Georgia.

We may have endured defeat at the hands of the Russians in the Second West Russian War but like we have before, Germany will rebuild itself and face off against the rats, no matter where they dare show themselves.
strings.GER_Hungarian_civil_war_category_desc:
As one of the first nations to sign the Tripartite Pact in the glory years of the 1940s, Hungary has been a valuable ally to the German order in Europe for decades. When the Italians failed to pry the country from our claws several years ago, we assumed that Budapest would remain an unwavering outpost of German ideals in the Balkans for many decades to come.

This reality has not come to pass.

In the wake of our embarrassing defeat to the Slavic menace in the Second West Russian War and the complete loss of our eastern holdings, Béla Imrédy has disappeared, with Ferenc Szálasi taking his place as dictator in Hungary. It seems that the local populace is unhappy with this development, and the country has fractured into a three-way civil war. A direct intervention is out of the question until it is certain that no Russian interference in Hungarian affairs is present; if we are able to take back the Danube with covert assistance to Szálasi, however, then we could ensure that Hungary remains in our grasp for generations to come.
strings.GER_AFG_WAR_sent_army_small: Send a small group of troops
strings.GER_AFG_WAR_use_gas_in_small_piece: Use gas bombs in a small area
strings.GER_AFG_WAR_fenik_power: The factory is in full swing
strings.GER_AFG_WAR_sent_army_large: Send a large number of troops
strings.GER_AFG_WAR_GAS_HOLYSHIT_GAS_AFG: Drop gas bombs on the whole territory of Tajikistan!
strings.GER_AFG_WAR_DESC: War in Afghanistan Current Conflict Level: Level {AFG_WAR_stage}
strings.GER_war_exhaustion_desc:
The Second West Russian War has already been proven to be the largest military conflict since its predecessor, and will quite possibly be remembered as the largest military conflict since the Second World War. With death and desctruction on such a massive scale, the civilian population as well as the soldiers have become increasingly disillusioned with the war effort.

If we build up too much War Exhaustion we will risk our frontlines getting bogged down

strings.GER_A_Spectre_Haunts_Germany_desc:
Our nation has been shockingly and violently attacked by the Slavic menace from the east, this time donned in black instead of red. This war promises to be much more brutal and violent than any our people have faced before, as already horrific attacks have been carried out against our civilian populations in the opening hours of this conflict. Unimaginable horrors may yet be unleashed on our people as the Slavic beast rises in one last attempt to take down our glorious civilization.

We must not bend or break. We will stand tall against our foes, beat them back across our borders and secure our Reich for a thousand years. And, after all the ashes of the war have settled across the plains of Russia, we will make them pay for their insolence and hubris.
strings.GER_The_Rapture_desc:
It is often said that history repeats, and this is undeniable proof that is the case. Two decades ago, the Russian horde crossed the Arkhangelsk-Astrakhan line with a sudden and unrelenting offensive, resulting in them reaching within a hair’s length of Moscow before being pushed back. Now, it seems this so-called Black League is making another attempt.  However, the offensive is proving more dangerous this time, the attack is much more organized and with much greater material backing, OFN involvement is suspected.

But we cannot fall to shock, this has been a sudden blow we should’ve seen coming, but we’ve come back from this before. We will send reinforcements east with our best generals and officers, and draw up a new defensive plan. We will analyze their tactics and strategy, and develop the best counters to them. We will march all the way to Omsk, and make sure this never happens again.
strings.GER_Revitalizing_The_OKW_desc:
The Oberkommando Wehrmacht has grown complacent, and is in a suboptimal state. The generals, officers and staff as a whole feel assured of an easy victory and as such are not applying themselves to solve the crisis we face. We must introduce newly promoted staff and make the existing ones sit up and listen. We are facing a great danger and their expertise will be of vital importance. We will outline the problem to them and once the situation is abundantly clear, their work can begin in earnest. We shall commence organizing army groups and logistics, appointing the right generals to lead the armies and ensuring that everyone is doing their part to uphold our dominant position.

The task of ensuring a wartime economy must be properly organized and maintained so that the right numbers of materials, munitions and manpower reach the frontlines. German military prowess has never been in doubt, from the days of Prussia up to the West Russian War. We will not allow the fears of atrophy to creep in now.
strings.GER_No_Town_Untouched_desc:
It may seem to be a drastic measure, but the efficacy of such tactics in denying the enemy useful supplies, materials, and cover cannot be debated. “Scorched Earth” as it has become known must become part of our doctrine in defensive battles. As disheartening as a retreat might be, it can be lessened by setting ablaze anything of use that we cannot carry with us. This can leave the enemy off balance and hurting for supplies, making a counterattack much more viable. In the vast expanses of the east, this will have great effect.

It will take time to rebuild villages and supply caches once the war is over, but we will have all the time in the world to do so once the threat of the Black League has been well and truly extinguished. Even if we have to inflict collateral damage in order to do it, the ends will justify the means.
strings.GER_Fleecing_The_Corporations_desc:
As much as we are loath to admit it, certain difficulties have begun to arise in the logistical aspect of our war with the Black League. Deficits of arms, munitions, vehicles, supplies and other war materials have been identified and are beginning to cause major problems. Unfortunately. our current production cannot keep up, and this deficit threatens to grow larger. We are forced to turn to the private sector of our economy to bring the logistical situation under control.

If they expect us to come to them cap in hand then they will be mistaken. We have the means to apply pressure to them in legal and economic ways to bend them to our desires. It may hurt our relations with them, but these private companies have grown fat and decadent on the fruits of slave labor. It is time to whip them into shape.
strings.GER_Our_Past_Trials_desc:
History can be considered a series of themes and patterns, and learning from the past is often the key to facing new challenges. That wisdom can also be applied here, the First West Russian War forced us to adapt in new and interesting ways, and we cannot let those lessons go to waste due to the hubris and ego of our current general staff. We shall open the logbooks and call on the veterans to review how the previous war was won, and apply those strategies and tactics once more, from the general to the private.

Having to learn these lessons all over again is much too slow a process. This will also give a job to the many veterans of the previous war who may not be able to serve directly, they can pass on their knowledge and experience as trainers and advisors.
strings.GER_A_Wall_Of_Water_And_Mud: A Wall of Water and Mud
strings.GER_A_Wall_Of_Water_And_Mud_desc: The mighty Dnipro Reservoir Cascade is Ukraine's lifeline, impounding billions of cubic meters of water in its relentless grasp. Its presence fuels the heartbeat of the territory, bestowing water and electricity to the Reich's coveted breadbasket. But it can serve a tactical purpose. By releasing its floodgates, we can unleash a monstrous deluge flooding its drainage basin, rendering the once-familiar terrain nearly impassable, an insurmountable barrier sure to halt the pillaging Slavic hordes' advances any further. Although there are substantial logistical and tactical issues to consider, the dams can serve a very powerful purpose, possibly enough to change the tide of the war and shatter the Russian state once and for all.
strings.GER_Render_Unto_Caesar_desc:
One of the many problems we are facing is the bottomless financial pit that the eastern territories have thus far proven to be, vast sums of money, resources and manpower only to receive mediocrity in return. This can no longer be allowed to stand, we have given them so very much, is it not unreasonable to begin to expect something in return? It is high time that they earned their keep, and paid back the vast sums we invested in them.

The war is proving costly in every sense of the word, and it is not merely recognition for the contributions that we must demand of them. Products of industry, food, raw materials and other such goods which will be of vital necessity for the war effort  Quotas will be set and tightly held, so to ensure that the dues we are owed are rightfully collected. A return on investment is a reasonable expectation, and now more than ever such an expectation must be met.
strings.GER_Every_Inch_A_Battleground_desc:
Gases, toxic substances, chemical weapons, and in some cases biological weapons - this is the only areas in which the Black League has got ahead of us. Unfortunately, we are forced to admit to ourselves that our ground forces' main losses aren't being suffered in direct combat with the Russians, but from such indirect weapons of mass destruction. The Eastern Front has become akin to the Western Front in the early years of the First World War.

Our difficult logistical task is to provide all our soldiers with the means to counter these threats. Gas masks, special uniforms and hygiene supplies, together with medical equipment, must ensure the resilience of our soldiers. By committing war crimes and failing to observe any rules of warfare, the Black League has signed its own death warrant - annihilation at the hands of the combined forces of the Einheitspakt.
strings.GER_The_White_Horse: On A White Horse, Sat Conquest
strings.GER_The_White_Horse_desc:
Our infantry, our airmen, our sailors - they are all part of our past and present victories, of our undisputed greatness. This Eastern horde fails to realise the utter folly of the war they have started, a war that will send their people and soldiers to their graves.

The Wehrmacht isn't merely a force for the security and defence of the Thousand-Year Reich - it's a true army of conquest, unrivalled in its kind. The simple explanation for this lies in their courage, their devotion to National Socialism, and their capacity for self-sacrifice in the name of the Aryan Fatherland. Our eastern enemy didn't realise this; having decided to tempt fate once more, well, this time it was the last...
strings.GER_All_For_The_Reich_desc:
There can be no victory without the backing of industry, without popular support, the utmost dedication of the government and administration at all levels. The ferocity and persistence of the attack against us by the Black League has made it abundantly clear that this will be a fight to the death. But not ours. Every single factory and workshop will produce arms, munitions, vehicles, equipment and all else needed for our armies to stop the offensive and turn it back to the heart of the Russian monster once and for all.

Every spare crumb of food will be diverted to our soldiers, civilians have made do with rationing before and this can be implemented fairly without causing famine. We can also requisition shipments of iron, coal, tungsten and copper from civilian industries, as the military needs them more. The Fuhrer will also deliver a speech announcing the reintroduction of conscription to ensure that our regiments always have an ample supply of manpower.
strings.GER_An_Engine_Ran_On_Blood_desc:
In such a large-scale war on the eastern fronts of our Lebensraum, the size of the armies plays a key role. Therefore, in order to cement the fact of our unquestionable victory and the capitulation of Omsk, we must continue to recruit new recruits into the Wehrmacht by stepping up conscription.

By launching a series of information operations and covert propaganda campaigns aimed at the masses, we will ensure the timely rotation and full manning of our divisions. The war is not an easy one - it's a terrible one, yet it will determine the future of the entire German hegemony. The question is not who'll kill whom, but whether the Aryan race will remain dominant in Europe.
strings.GER_The_National_Struggle_desc:
As any propagandist will tell you, you can spin almost anything into being positive or negative with the right words and framing. As such, we must bring to the nation’s attention the indelible fact that we are the superior people, which has been proven time and again for all to see. We will stand shoulder to shoulder as a bold and proud people against the animalistic aggression of the Slavic horde. We as contemporary Spartans have turned back many enemies in different forms, and this will be no different. Have no fear, people of the Reich, for victory is assured. All that remains is to make it official.

We can push this through television, newspapers, radio and all other means to ensure that this vitally important message reaches everyone within the Reich’s borders. Every spirit will be ignited, and with souls aflame we will claim a final and resounding victory.
strings.GER_The_Many_Talons_Of_The_Eagle_desc:
To some, it may seem as if we stand alone against the Slavic hordes to the east. That we are isolated and weak in a hostile world. They are wrong. We are the masters of Europe, a continent conquered by our will decades ago, remade to serve us and to obey us. The Pakt is our greatest achievement and weapon, and it is time to harness it.

We stand on the precipice, with our greatest of enemies threatening to undo all that we have accomplished. For the good of the nation, party, and people, they must be destroyed by any means necessary. We will treat every appendage of our alliance as if it was our very nation, for Germany and Germany alone rules Europe, and Germany and Germany alone will rule it forevermore.
strings.GER_Fan_The_Winds_Of_Desperation_desc:
Although we firmly believe in victory, introducing a sense of urgency to the situation will help in encouraging people to make more inventive solutions. The hand is around our throat! The gun at our head! You must act right this second now! Sentiments such as these have been expressed by alarmists both in the government and army as well as in the civilian population. It may seem unorthodox, but panic can be refined into motivation.

All it takes for this to bear fruit is for a few people to lay down a creative solution to an existing problem. A way to produce guns a little faster, refine petrol a little more efficiently, or a corner that can be safely cut in the bureaucracy and other small things will begin to add up. It will be an unconventional edge, but in the position we’re in we cannot afford to turn our nose up at any potential advantage.
strings.GER_There_Is_No_Want_desc:
Autarky. The system of self-sufficiency where it comes to societies, states and their economic systems. During the Second World War, it proved invaluable in maintaining the Reich’s economic and societal stability, cutting down on the need for imported goods. We have no need for such excesses anyway. The ever resilient people will only consume what is needed for life and nothing more, and that much the government will provide.

There are, however, some who quite selfishly hoard and stockpile, depriving their neighbors and communities of goods which, in their foolishness, pride and paranoia believe that they are more deserving of. Perfectly good food rots away unused because of this, and such wastage is unacceptable. We will properly enforce autarky, and root out those who attempt to circumvent it.
strings.GER_Only_What_Must_Be_Done_desc:
Since we have formally instituted these extreme autarky policies throughout Germany and our territories, a flood of resources from our civilian population has begun to flow its way into the hands of our men on the frontline. The issue we face now, however, is that it is still not enough.

With that said, we must do only what must be done. We will need to secure more resources from the civilian population and distribute it all back to our troops. Food and fuel rationing must be increased, alongside the trucks and cars that serve our people must be repurposed for the war effort. It will hurt us in the short term, but victory must be achieved at any cost.
strings.GER_Black_Horse: On A Black Horse, Sat Famine
strings.GER_Black_Horse_desc:
Fluch! Our worst fears regarding food security are beginning to come true! Supplies and food that used to reach us from the fertile Ukrainian fields are, at best, being delayed; at worst, they have stopped arriving altogether. This is all because, as of recently, the Führer's directive has been to divert food resources directly to the front, rather than to the Fatherland.

Although there is enough basic food for civilians, they sometimes cannot find even meat or dairy products in the shops, which is putting pressure on our private businesses. We are forced to allocate state funds from the annual budget to cover businesses' debts so that they don't go completely bankrupt. We hope this will postpone the risk of famine, the storm clouds of which are already gradually gathering.
strings.GER_Vengeance_Incarnate_desc:
This conflict, its size and as well as the apparent hardline rhetoric of our enemy, is much larger in scope than just between the Reich and Russia. These fanatics are in possession of nuclear weapons, a combination akin to a pool of petroleum and a dozen lit matches. There’s no doubt that this clear and present danger has made itself obvious to other powers in the world, we must extend earnest words through diplomatic channels to said other powers.

As much as it may pain us to admit this, it was not the Reich alone which conquered Europe. We had allies, and we must play this card again. By reaching out to nations abroad, this could grant us a stream of favorable trade deals, or ideally more direct support. This is not desperation, this is us making it clear to the international community that this is their problem too.
strings.GER_A_Meeting_Of_Necessity_desc:
The Reich is not always known for its humility. The Eagle never gave pittance to the mice in its talons. Nevertheless, the world now is faced with a truly existential threat and we must swallow our pride. The Americans in their packed office and the Japanese in their pagoda are our proven enemies, but we need to meet for the sake of all of our survival. We will show whatever evidence we need, say whatever needed to get this unholy alliance through, for the sake of our survival. All metaphorical bets are off of the table.

After all, what is the alternative? An Unholy Alliance is the better alternative to a world ruled by rabid cultists, obsessed with what they call a “Great Trial”, by any and all means. They must understand that our existence is preferable to a world coated in sarin gas and radiation. If not, only God can guarantee our survival now.
strings.GER_Old_Friends_In_Rome_desc:
Our relationship with the Italian government has decayed over the years, since the time of the Axis. Nonetheless, there exists the groundwork for us to foster a new alliance of sorts. It may require us to swallow some pride and perhaps give a concession or two, but the circumstances the Black League has put us in warrants more desperate measures. The Italians will more than likely be aware of this, which may serve to make them more receptive. As such, diplomatic channels must be opened.

We will make our needs clear to them, as this is not the time to be playing mind games and engaging in a competition of petty one-ups. We will request economic support, light or heavy industrial imports, business investment or perhaps even any sort of military support. We will attempt to tap them for whatever they care to give us. A substantial price may be incurred, but our diplomats will negotiate fair deals.
strings.GER_Sins_Of_The_Demons_Revealed: Let Them Witness the True League
strings.GER_Sins_Of_The_Demons_Revealed_desc:
There has been some idea of the Black League, some notion of plurality. The Americans and many parts of the uncivilized world see the League as some sort of comeuppance for the Reich. These childish ideas will be disproven when the world is dragged kicking and screaming into a new age. By our calculations and estimates a nuclear exchange will spill over into the rest of the world. We do not need to stage any incidents with the League, they have proven more than capable to spill our pure blood all over the tapestry of Europe.

All we must do is record and show to the world and they shall turn against the League in due time.
strings.GER_Comrades_In_The_Balkans_desc:
This war we find ourselves in will not be the end of just the German peoples, but that of all our allies that have fought diligently for our cause. Our allies in the Balkan region were once called upon to aid us in our victory during the Second World War but did not see the action our troops faced during the First West Russian War. We shall not make that same mistake again.

They must call upon their militaries to assist us in keeping back the Black League at all costs. Any material shortcomings they might endure in this conflict will be handled by us, and if they refuse our call to arms, we must remind them why we are the master of Europe.
strings.GER_Against_The_Maelstrom_Of_Hatred_desc: The illegitimate Russian state is viewed as a threat by nearly everyone on the international stage, and while we may have our disagreements, it is a necessary precaution to form an aegis with both the Organization of Free Nations and the Co-Prosperity Sphere, in hopes of forever tearing down this short-lived, degenerate excuse of a government. We will make sure with the power of the entire collective, industrialized world, that the Reich prevails in this costly conflict.
strings.GER_On_A_Red_Horse_Sat_War: On A Red Horse, Sat War
strings.GER_On_A_Red_Horse_Sat_War_desc:
War, war never changes... Nor does the nature of the Russians, who throughout their pitiful history have fought for their imperial grandeur. Not this time! They'll come to regret their attempt to challenge the Aryan warriors once again when the fighting rages in the Ural Mountains.

The front line is not static, in some places we are making gains, whilst in others the enemy is advancing - we mustn't forget our duty to uphold the doctrine of offensive warfare. History has shown that only the side in the war that is more resolute than the enemy emerges victorious. We are fighting not only for the Führer or the Fatherland, but also for the preservation and supremacy of the Aryan nation. All the Reich's military personnel must bear this in mind, from the impassioned speeches of officers to their brigades, right up to the highest military leadership of the Wehrmacht.
strings.GER_Riding_On_A_Pale_Horse_Came_Death: Riding On A Pale Horse, Came Death
strings.GER_Riding_On_A_Pale_Horse_Came_Death_de:
More and more territories of the Reichskommissariat Moskowien are being lost, ravaged by death. Charred trees, and in some places rivers, stained a blood-red colour, are no longer an artistic interpretation of this horrific war - but its reality. By razing the landscape, the Russians seek to leave our brave Aryan warriors without any shelters where they might take refuge from their chemical attacks.

That devilish Glavkoverkh is determined to employ every possible - and impossible - means to inflict as many casualties on us as possible. It's a futile strategy, for our territories in Eastern Europe are far more extensive than the so-called West Russia under their control. Even if they were to occupy a significant part of one Reichskommissariat, they would run into the territory of another, wasting even more of their soldiers' lives. They simply don't have enough resources and manpower even to get close to the lands of our Fatherland, so we are duty-bound to triumph in this meat grinder!

strings.GER_biologic_warfare_dynmod_desc:
The Great Trial has begun and the Black League has already made its opening move. In massive bombing campaigns, biological weapons have been deployed in both our cities and on the frontline en masse. The effects are already taking a toll on our country and our ability to defend ourselves from their aggression.

Their weapons are indiscriminate. For every one of our soldiers that's killed, an equal number of civilian lives are taken. The Black League has set the scene for this war already:

This is a War of Annihilation.
